<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en"><head><script>(function () {
  ['pushState', 'replaceState'].forEach(function (method) {
    var original = history[method];
    history[method] = function () {
      try { return original.apply(history, arguments); } catch (e) { /* opaque origin, ignore */ }
    };
  });
})();</script>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Bored Chat</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<!-- Firebase (compat SDK) -->
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.13.0/firebase-database-compat.js"></script>

<style>
  :root{
    --bg-rail:#1e1f22;
    --bg-list:#2b2d31;
    --bg-chat:#313338;
    --bg-input:#383a40;
    --bg-hover:#3a3c43;
    --blurple:#5865f2;
    --blurple-hover:#4752c4;
    --online:#23a55a;
    --danger:#f23f42;
    --danger-hover:#da373c;
    --gold:#f0b232;
    --text-bright:#f2f3f5;
    --text-normal:#dbdee1;
    --text-muted:#949ba4;
    --text-faint:#6a6e77;
    --border:#232428;
    --mention-bg:rgba(88,101,242,0.1);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;background:var(--bg-rail);font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;color:var(--text-normal);overflow:hidden;}
  #app{position:relative;width:100%;height:100vh;overflow:hidden;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:8px;height:8px;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#1a1b1e;border-radius:4px;}

  /* ---- auth screen ---- */
  #authScreen{
    position:relative;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    flex-direction:column;text-align:center;padding:20px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 20%, #3a3d6b 0%, transparent 45%),
               radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, #2a2140 0%, transparent 50%),
               var(--bg-rail);
  }
  .logo-mark{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--blurple);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(88,101,242,0.4);}
  .logo-word{font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);letter-spacing:-0.5px;margin-bottom:4px;}
  .tagline{color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:30px;font-size:0.92rem;}
  .auth-card{width:100%;max-width:380px;background:var(--bg-chat);border-radius:8px;padding:32px 28px;box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);}
  .auth-card h2{margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--text-bright);font-size:1.35rem;}
  .auth-card p.sub{margin:0 0 20px;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.85rem;}
  .tabs{display:flex;margin-bottom:20px;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg-input);}
  .tab-btn{flex:1;padding:9px 0;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);font-family:'Inter';font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.84rem;transition:all .15s;}
  .tab-btn.active{background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .field{margin-bottom:16px;text-align:left;}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.3px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:7px;}
  .field input{width:100%;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.95rem;outline:none;transition:border .15s;}
  .field input:focus{border-color:var(--blurple);}
  .primary-btn{width:100%;padding:11px;border:none;border-radius:4px;background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:0.92rem;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;margin-top:6px;}
  .primary-btn:hover{background:var(--blurple-hover);}
  .primary-btn:disabled{opacity:0.55;cursor:not-allowed;}
  .ghost-btn{width:100%;padding:10px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:8px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:600;font-size:0.85rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .ghost-btn:hover{border-color:var(--text-muted);color:var(--text-normal);}
  .auth-msg{min-height:18px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--danger);margin-top:10px;word-break:break-word;text-align:left;}

  .yt-banner{margin-top:24px;max-width:380px;width:100%;background:var(--bg-chat);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:13px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--text-normal);transition:border-color .15s;}
  .yt-banner:hover{border-color:var(--danger);}
  .yt-icon{width:32px;height:32px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:8px;background:var(--danger);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  .yt-icon svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:#fff;}
  .yt-text{text-align:left;line-height:1.3;}
  .yt-text b{font-size:0.86rem;}
  .yt-text span{font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-muted);}

  /* ---- chat screen ---- */
  #chatScreen{position:relative;height:100%;display:none;flex-direction:row;}

  .avatar{border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:var(--blurple);}
  .avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
  .avatar-xs{width:20px;height:20px;font-size:0.6rem;}
  .avatar-sm{width:32px;height:32px;font-size:0.8rem;}
  .avatar-md{width:40px;height:40px;font-size:0.9rem;}
  .presence-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:0 0 auto;border:3px solid var(--bg-list);background:var(--text-faint);margin-left:-12px;margin-top:14px;}
  .presence-dot.online{background:var(--online);}

  /* ---- server rail ---- */
  #serverRail{width:72px;flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg-rail);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:12px 0;gap:8px;}
  .rail-icon{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg-list);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.3rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;color:var(--text-normal);position:relative;}
  .rail-icon:hover, .rail-icon.active{border-radius:16px;background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .rail-icon.active::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:-12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:4px;height:24px;background:#fff;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;}
  .rail-divider{width:32px;height:2px;background:var(--border);border-radius:1px;margin:2px 0;}

  /* ---- channel list column ---- */
  #chanCol{width:240px;flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg-list);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;}
  #chanColHeader{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);font-size:0.98rem;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15);}

  .voice-status-bar{display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 12px;background:#292b2f;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--online);margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
  .voice-status-bar.show{display:flex;}
  .voice-status-bar span.vname{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .voice-status-bar button{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(242,63,66,0.4);color:var(--danger);border-radius:4px;font-size:0.68rem;padding:3px 7px;cursor:pointer;}

  .sidebar-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:10px 8px 6px;}
  .sidebar-tab-btn{flex:1;padding:7px 0;border-radius:4px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:600;font-size:0.76rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;letter-spacing:0.2px;}
  .sidebar-tab-btn.active{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  .sidebar-tab-btn .badge-dot{display:inline-block;min-width:16px;height:16px;line-height:16px;background:var(--danger);color:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:0.62rem;margin-left:4px;padding:0 4px;}

  .sidebar-section-title{font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);margin:14px 0 4px;padding:0 12px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;}
  .new-group-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:color .15s;line-height:1;}
  .new-group-btn:hover{color:var(--text-bright);}
  .add-friend-row{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:0 8px;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .add-friend-row input{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.8rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';}
  .add-friend-row input:focus{border-color:var(--blurple);}
  .add-friend-row button{border:none;border-radius:4px;padding:0 12px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.76rem;font-weight:600;background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .add-friend-row button:hover{background:var(--blurple-hover);}
  .add-friend-msg{font-size:0.72rem;min-height:16px;margin:2px 12px 6px;color:var(--danger);}
  .add-friend-msg.ok{color:var(--online);}

  #panelScroll{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding-bottom:10px;}
  .empty-list-note{color:var(--text-faint);font-size:0.76rem;padding:10px 14px;text-align:center;}

  .list-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-muted);transition:all .1s;margin:1px 8px;}
  .list-item:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-normal);}
  .list-item.active{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  .list-item .item-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .list-item .hash{opacity:0.55;font-weight:600;}
  .list-item .mini-btn{opacity:0;background:transparent;border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.82rem;padding:0 3px;line-height:1;}
  .list-item:hover .mini-btn{opacity:0.85;}
  .list-item .mini-btn.call{color:var(--online);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.video{color:var(--blurple);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.del, .list-item .mini-btn.block{color:var(--danger);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.nick{color:var(--gold);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.invite{color:var(--blurple);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.addppl{color:var(--online);}
  .list-item .mini-btn.leave{color:var(--gold);}
  .list-item .voice-count{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--online);white-space:nowrap;}
  .list-item .public-tag{font-size:0.62rem;color:var(--text-faint);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:3px;padding:1px 4px;}

  .request-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:0.82rem;background:var(--bg-chat);margin:0 8px 6px;}
  .request-row .req-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;color:var(--text-normal);}
  .request-row button{border:none;border-radius:4px;padding:5px 9px;font-size:0.72rem;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;}
  .req-accept{background:var(--online);color:#fff;}
  .req-decline, .req-cancel, .req-unblock{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-muted);}
  .req-decline:hover, .req-cancel:hover{border-color:var(--danger);color:var(--danger);}
  .req-unblock:hover{border-color:var(--online);color:var(--online);}

  /* ---- bottom user bar ---- */
  #userBar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 8px;background:#232428;flex:0 0 auto;}
  #userBar .user-block{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex:1;min-width:0;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;border-radius:4px;}
  #userBar .user-block:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);}
  #userBar .user-info{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
  #userBar .user-info b{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--text-bright);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:110px;}
  #userBar .user-info span{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-muted);}
  #userBar .bar-icon-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;padding:6px;border-radius:4px;}
  #userBar .bar-icon-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}

  /* ---- main chat column ---- */
  #chatMain{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;background:var(--bg-chat);}

  .chat-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.1);}
  .chat-header .header-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;}
  .sidebar-toggle-btn{display:none;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.1rem;}
  .current-chat-label-wrap{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0;}
  .current-chat-label{font-size:0.98rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}
  .current-chat-sub{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);white-space:nowrap;}
  .header-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .call-header-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .call-header-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--online);}
  .call-header-btn.video:hover{color:var(--blurple);}
  .chan-action-btn{background:var(--bg-input);border:none;color:var(--text-normal);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.76rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .chan-action-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  .chan-action-btn.warn:hover{color:var(--gold);}
  .my-profile-btn{background:none;border:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;display:none;}
  .admin-badge{background:#ffd60a;color:#1e1f22;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.4px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,214,10,0.4);}
  .conn-pill{padding:5px 10px;border-radius:4px;font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-muted);background:var(--bg-input);}
  .conn-pill.online{color:var(--online);}
  .conn-pill.offline{color:var(--danger);}
  .logout-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .logout-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--danger);}

  .promo-strip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(88,101,242,0.08);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 16px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-muted);flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .promo-strip a{color:#a6b1ff;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;}
  .promo-strip a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}

  /* ---- voice channel panel ---- */
  .voice-panel{display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:#2b2d31;}
  .voice-panel.show{display:flex;}
  .voice-panel .voice-join-btn{border:none;border-radius:4px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--online);color:#fff;}
  .voice-panel .voice-join-btn.leave{background:var(--danger);}
  .voice-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:16px;padding:4px 10px 4px 4px;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--text-normal);}

  #messages{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;}
  .msg{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;max-width:100%;}
  .msg:hover{background:rgba(4,4,5,0.15);}
  .msg .avatar-slot{flex:0 0 auto;width:40px;padding-top:2px;}
  .msg .msg-body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .msg .name-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin-bottom:2px;}
  .msg .name-row .who{font-weight:600;font-size:0.9rem;color:var(--text-bright);}
  .msg .name-row .when{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-faint);}
  .msg .bubble{font-size:0.92rem;line-height:1.4;word-wrap:break-word;white-space:pre-wrap;color:var(--text-normal);}
  .msg.me .name-row .who{color:#a6b1ff;}
  .msg-actions{display:none;gap:2px;margin-left:auto;padding-top:2px;}
  .msg:hover .msg-actions{display:flex;}
  .msg-del-btn, .msg-block-btn{background:var(--bg-input);border:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.78rem;padding:4px 6px;border-radius:4px;color:var(--text-muted);}
  .msg-del-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);}
  .msg-block-btn:hover{color:var(--text-bright);}

  #typingBar{min-height:22px;padding:0 16px;font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--text-muted);font-style:italic;}

  #composer{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:0 16px 20px;align-items:center;}
  #attachBtn{flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg-input);border:none;color:var(--text-muted);width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  #attachBtn:hover{color:var(--text-bright);background:var(--bg-hover);}
  .msg-media{max-width:320px;max-height:280px;border-radius:8px;margin-top:6px;display:block;cursor:pointer;}
  .owner-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px;background:#ffd60a;color:#1e1f22;font-size:0.62rem;font-weight:700;padding:1px 6px;border-radius:3px;letter-spacing:0.2px;vertical-align:middle;}
  .muted-tag{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-faint);}
  .mini-btn.mute{color:var(--gold);}
  .mini-btn.ban{color:var(--danger);}
  #msgInputWrap{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px;}
  #msgInput{flex:1;padding:12px 8px;background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.94rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';}
  #sendBtn{padding:0 16px;border:none;background:transparent;color:var(--blurple);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.85rem;}
  #sendBtn:hover{color:var(--blurple-hover);}
  #sendBtn:disabled{opacity:0.4;cursor:not-allowed;}
  .empty-state{text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:60px;font-size:0.9rem;}
  .empty-state .glyph{font-size:2.4rem;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:0.5;}
  .composer-note{padding:0 16px 14px;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--gold);}

  /* ---- modal overlay ---- */
  .modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.72);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;}
  .modal-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .modal-card{width:100%;max-width:360px;background:var(--bg-chat);border-radius:8px;padding:24px 22px;box-shadow:0 12px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);text-align:left;max-height:82vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
  .modal-card h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--text-bright);}
  .modal-card p.sub{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--text-muted);}
  .modal-card input{width:100%;padding:10px 11px;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.95rem;outline:none;margin-bottom:12px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .modal-card input:focus{border-color:var(--blurple);}
  .modal-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:4px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .modal-actions button{flex:1;}
  .modal-err{min-height:16px;font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--danger);margin:-4px 0 10px;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .modal-err.ok{color:var(--online);}
  .member-picker{overflow-y:auto;flex:1;margin-bottom:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 0;min-height:60px;}
  .member-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:7px 4px;font-size:0.86rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-normal);}
  .member-row input{width:auto;margin:0;flex:0 0 auto;}
  .member-row span{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .inline-row{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .inline-row input{margin-bottom:0;}
  .inline-row button{border:none;border-radius:4px;background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:0.8rem;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;}
  .inline-row button:hover{background:var(--blurple-hover);}
  .type-choice{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .type-choice button{flex:1;padding:9px 6px;border-radius:4px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:transparent;color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:600;font-size:0.78rem;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Inter';}
  .type-choice button.active{background:var(--blurple);border-color:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .code-box{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:1.5rem;letter-spacing:4px;text-align:center;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:16px;color:var(--text-bright);margin-bottom:12px;user-select:all;}
  .modal-note{font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-faint);margin:0 0 12px;}

  /* ---- search bar ---- */
  .search-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .search-btn:hover, .search-btn.active{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  #searchBar{display:none;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg-input);}
  #searchBar.open{display:flex;}
  #searchInput{flex:1;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:4px;background:#1e1f22;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);font-size:0.86rem;outline:none;font-family:'Inter';}
  #searchInput:focus{border-color:var(--blurple);}
  #searchCount{font-size:0.74rem;color:var(--text-muted);white-space:nowrap;min-width:56px;text-align:right;}
  .search-close-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;padding:2px 4px;}
  .search-close-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);}
  mark.hl{background:rgba(240,178,50,0.4);color:inherit;border-radius:2px;padding:0 1px;}
  .msg.dimmed{opacity:0.28;}

  /* ---- calling overlays ---- */
  .call-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:30;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.9);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;padding:24px;}
  .call-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .call-avatar{width:100px;height:100px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blurple);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.2rem;color:#fff;animation:pulseRing 1.6s ease-out infinite;margin-bottom:18px;}
  @keyframes pulseRing{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(88,101,242,0.55);}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 28px rgba(88,101,242,0);}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(88,101,242,0);}}
  .call-peer-name{font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-bright);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .call-status-text{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:28px;}
  .call-btn-row{display:flex;gap:22px;}
  .round-btn{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.4rem;transition:transform .15s;}
  .round-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);}
  .round-btn.accept{background:var(--online);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.decline, .round-btn.hangup{background:var(--danger);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.mute{background:var(--bg-input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);}
  .round-btn.mute.active{background:var(--danger);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.vidtoggle{background:var(--bg-input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);}
  .round-btn.vidtoggle.active{background:var(--blurple);color:#fff;}
  .round-btn.sharetoggle{background:var(--bg-input);border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-normal);}
  .round-btn.sharetoggle.active{background:var(--online);color:#fff;}

  #inCallOverlay{justify-content:flex-end;}
  .in-call-videos{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:640px;flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
  #remoteVideoEl{width:100%;max-height:60vh;border-radius:12px;background:#1e1f22;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--border);}
  #localVideoEl{position:absolute;bottom:12px;right:12px;width:110px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:#1e1f22;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);}
  .in-call-audio-mode #remoteVideoEl, .in-call-audio-mode #localVideoEl{display:none;}
  .call-timer{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:0.82rem;margin:14px 0 18px;}

  /* ---- minimized / docked call bar (lets you keep using chat during a call) ---- */
  .call-overlay.docked{
    position:fixed;inset:auto;left:auto;right:16px;bottom:16px;top:auto;
    width:280px;max-width:calc(100vw - 32px);height:auto;
    background:var(--bg-chat);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;
    box-shadow:0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);padding:14px;z-index:25;
  }
  .call-overlay.docked .in-call-videos{max-width:100%;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .call-overlay.docked #remoteVideoEl{max-height:150px;}
  .call-overlay.docked #localVideoEl{width:64px;bottom:8px;right:8px;}
  .call-overlay.docked .call-avatar{width:56px;height:56px;font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:8px;}
  .call-overlay.docked .call-peer-name{font-size:0.92rem;margin-bottom:0;}
  .call-overlay.docked .call-timer{font-size:0.72rem;margin:2px 0 10px;}
  .call-overlay.docked .call-btn-row{gap:10px;}
  .call-overlay.docked .round-btn{width:42px;height:42px;font-size:1.05rem;}
  .dock-toggle-btn{
    position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;background:var(--bg-input);border:none;color:var(--text-muted);
    width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.85rem;display:flex;
    align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:1;
  }
  .dock-toggle-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  #inCallOverlay.open{ pointer-events:none; }
  #inCallOverlay.open > *{ pointer-events:auto; }
  #inCallOverlay:not(.docked){ background:rgba(0,0,0,0.9); }
  #inCallOverlay.docked{ background:transparent; }

  /* ---- online users panel (right side) ---- */
  #onlineCol{width:220px;flex:0 0 auto;background:var(--bg-list);border-left:1px solid var(--border);display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;}
  #onlineColHeader{padding:16px 16px 8px;font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.4px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-muted);}
  #onlineColScroll{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:0 8px 12px;}
  .online-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--text-normal);margin-bottom:1px;position:relative;}
  .online-item:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);}
  .online-item .item-name{flex:1;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}
  .online-item .you-tag{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--text-faint);}
  .online-empty-note{color:var(--text-faint);font-size:0.78rem;padding:10px 8px;text-align:center;}

  /* ---- tutorial ---- */
  .tutorial-btn{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-muted);padding:6px;border-radius:4px;font-size:1.05rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .15s;}
  .tutorial-btn:hover{background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--text-bright);}
  #tutorialModal .modal-card{max-width:440px;}
  .tut-step{display:none;}
  .tut-step.active{display:block;}
  .tut-step h4{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--text-bright);font-size:1.02rem;}
  .tut-step p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-normal);line-height:1.5;}
  .tut-step .tut-glyph{font-size:1.8rem;margin-bottom:8px;display:block;}
  .tut-dots{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin:4px 0 14px;}
  .tut-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border);cursor:pointer;}
  .tut-dot.active{background:var(--blurple);}
  .tut-nav-row{display:flex;gap:10px;}
  .tut-skip-row{text-align:center;margin-top:8px;}
  .tut-skip-row button{background:transparent;border:none;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:0.76rem;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;}

  @media (max-width: 860px){
    #serverRail{display:none;}
    #onlineCol{display:none;}
  }
  @media (max-width: 720px){
    #chanCol{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;width:250px;z-index:8;transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .2s ease;}
    #chanCol.mobile-open{transform:translateX(0);}
    .sidebar-toggle-btn{display:inline-flex;}
    .my-profile-btn{display:inline-flex;}
    .list-item .mini-btn{opacity:0.7;}
    .call-overlay.docked{right:10px;bottom:10px;width:220px;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="app">

  <!-- AUTH SCREEN -->
  <div id="authScreen">
    <div class="logo-mark">B</div>
    <div class="logo-word">Bored Chat</div>
    <div class="tagline">Where your crew hangs out.</div>

    <div class="auth-card">
      <div class="tabs">
        <button class="tab-btn active" id="tabLogin" onclick="switchTab('login')">Log In</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" id="tabRegister" onclick="switchTab('register')">Create Account</button>
      </div>
      <form id="authForm" onsubmit="handleAuthSubmit(event)">
        <div class="field">
          <label>Username</label>
          <input type="text" id="usernameInput" autocomplete="username" required="" maxlength="20" placeholder="e.g. nightowl">
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Password</label>
          <input type="password" id="passwordInput" autocomplete="current-password" required="" minlength="4" placeholder="••••••••">
        </div>
        <button type="submit" class="primary-btn" id="submitBtn">Continue</button>
        <div class="auth-msg" id="authMsg"></div>
      </form>
      <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="openTutorial()" type="button">📖 How does this work?</button>
    </div>

    <a class="yt-banner" href="https://www.youtube.com/@ShadowDefender2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      <span class="yt-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"></path></svg></span>
      <span class="yt-text"><b>Subscribe to ShadowDefender2</b><br><span>on YouTube — join the crew 🔔</span></span>
    </a>
  </div>

  <!-- CHAT SCREEN -->
  <div id="chatScreen">

    <!-- SERVER RAIL -->
    <div id="serverRail">
      <div class="rail-icon active" title="Bored Chat" onclick="openGeneralChat()">B</div>
      <div class="rail-divider"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- CHANNEL COLUMN -->
    <div id="chanCol">
      <div id="chanColHeader">Bored Chat</div>

      <div class="sidebar-tabs">
        <button class="sidebar-tab-btn active" id="sidebarTabFriends" onclick="switchSidebarTab('friends')">Friends<span class="badge-dot" id="incomingReqBadge" style="display:none;"></span></button>
        <button class="sidebar-tab-btn" id="sidebarTabGroups" onclick="switchSidebarTab('groups')">Channels</button>
      </div>

      <div id="panelScroll">
        <!-- FRIENDS PANEL -->
        <div id="friendsPanel">
          <div class="general-nav-btn-wrap" style="padding:0 8px 6px;">
            <div class="list-item" id="generalNavBtn" onclick="openGeneralChat()" style="margin:0 0 6px;">
              <span class="hash">#</span><span class="item-name">general</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="add-friend-row">
            <input type="text" id="addFriendInput" placeholder="Add friend by username…" maxlength="20" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')sendFriendRequestFromInput()">
            <button onclick="sendFriendRequestFromInput()">Add</button>
          </div>
          <div class="add-friend-msg" id="addFriendMsg"></div>

          <div id="incomingRequestsBlock" style="display:none;">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title">Requests</div>
            <div id="incomingRequestsList"></div>
          </div>
          <div id="outgoingRequestsBlock" style="display:none;">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title">Pending</div>
            <div id="outgoingRequestsList"></div>
          </div>

          <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Direct Messages</span></div>
          <div id="friendsList"></div>

          <div id="blockedBlock" style="display:none;">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Blocked</span></div>
            <div id="blockedList"></div>
          </div>

          <div id="modBlock" style="display:none;">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Muted</span></div>
            <div id="mutedAdminList"></div>
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Banned</span></div>
            <div id="bannedAdminList"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- GROUPS PANEL -->
        <div id="groupsPanel" style="display:none;">
          <div class="add-friend-row" style="margin-top:4px;">
            <input type="text" id="joinCodeInput" placeholder="Join with an invite code…" maxlength="12" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')joinChannelByCode()">
            <button onclick="joinChannelByCode()">Join</button>
          </div>
          <div class="add-friend-msg" id="joinCodeMsg"></div>

          <div id="publicChannelsBlock">
            <div class="sidebar-section-title"><span>Public Channels</span></div>
            <div id="publicChannelsList"></div>
          </div>

          <div class="sidebar-section-title">
            <span>Your Channels</span>
            <button class="new-group-btn" onclick="openNewGroupModal()" title="Create channel">+</button>
          </div>
          <div id="groupsList"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="voice-status-bar" id="voiceStatusBar">
        🎙️ <span class="vname" id="voiceStatusName"></span>
        <button onclick="leaveVoiceChannel()">Leave</button>
      </div>

      <div id="userBar">
        <div class="user-block" onclick="openProfileModal()">
          <span id="currentUserAvatarSlot"></span>
          <div class="user-info">
            <b id="userBarName"></b>
            <span id="userBarStatus">Online</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span class="admin-badge" id="adminBadge" style="display:none;">👑 OWNER</span>
        <button class="bar-icon-btn" onclick="logout()" title="Log out">⏻</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- MAIN CHAT COLUMN -->
    <div id="chatMain">
      <div class="chat-header">
        <div class="header-left">
          <button class="sidebar-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleSidebarMobile()">☰</button>
          <div class="current-chat-label-wrap">
            <span class="current-chat-label" id="currentChatLabel"></span>
            <span class="current-chat-sub" id="currentChatSub"></span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="header-right">
          <button class="chan-action-btn" id="headerAddPeopleBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="openAddMemberModal()">+ Add people</button>
          <button class="chan-action-btn" id="headerInviteBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="openInviteModal()">🔗 Invite code</button>
          <button class="chan-action-btn warn" id="headerLeaveBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="leaveCurrentChannel()">Leave</button>
          <button class="call-header-btn" id="headerCallAudioBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="startCallWithCurrentFriend('audio')" title="Voice call">📞</button>
          <button class="call-header-btn video" id="headerCallVideoBtn" style="display:none;" onclick="startCallWithCurrentFriend('video')" title="Video call">🎥</button>
          <button class="search-btn" id="searchToggleBtn" onclick="toggleSearch()" title="Search messages">🔍</button>
          <button class="tutorial-btn" onclick="openTutorial()" title="How this works">❓</button>
          <span class="conn-pill" id="connPill">connecting…</span>
          <button class="my-profile-btn" onclick="openProfileModal()" title="Profile">👤</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="searchBar">
        <input type="text" id="searchInput" placeholder="Search this channel…" oninput="handleSearchInput()">
        <span id="searchCount"></span>
        <button class="search-close-btn" onclick="closeSearch()" title="Close search">✕</button>
      </div>

      <div class="promo-strip">
        🎥 Enjoying Bored Chat? Check out
        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@ShadowDefender2" target="_blank" rel="noopener">ShadowDefender2 on YouTube</a> and subscribe.
      </div>

      <div class="voice-panel" id="voicePanel">
        <button class="voice-join-btn" id="voiceJoinBtn" onclick="voiceJoinBtnClick()">🎙️ Join Voice</button>
        <div id="voiceChipsRow" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;flex:1;"></div>
      </div>

      <div id="messages"></div>
      <div id="typingBar"></div>
      <div class="composer-note" id="composerNote" style="display:none;">You're muted, so you can't send messages right now.</div>

      <div id="composer">
        <button id="attachBtn" onclick="openAttachMediaModal()" title="Send an image or video">📎</button>
        <div id="msgInputWrap">
          <input type="text" id="msgInput" placeholder="Message…" maxlength="500" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')sendMessage()" oninput="handleTypingInput()">
          <button id="sendBtn" onclick="sendMessage()">Send</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ONLINE USERS PANEL -->
    <div id="onlineCol">
      <div id="onlineColHeader">Online — <span id="onlineCount">0</span></div>
      <div id="onlineColScroll"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- NEW CHANNEL MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="newGroupModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Create a Channel</h3>
      <p class="sub">Anyone in a channel can invite more people later.</p>
      <div class="type-choice" id="newGroupTypeChoice" style="display:none;">
        <button id="typeBtnPrivate" class="active" onclick="setNewChannelType('group')">Invite only</button>
        <button id="typeBtnPublic" onclick="setNewChannelType('public')">Public (like #general)</button>
      </div>
      <input type="text" id="newGroupName" maxlength="24" placeholder="Channel name">
      <div id="newGroupPickerWrap">
        <div class="member-picker" id="newGroupMemberPicker"></div>
      </div>
      <p class="modal-note" id="newGroupNote">You'll get an invite code once it's created, so you can add people who aren't friends yet.</p>
      <div class="modal-err" id="newGroupErr"></div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="closeNewGroupModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="submitNewGroup()">Create channel</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ADD MEMBER MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="addMemberModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Add people</h3>
      <p class="sub">Add anyone by username, or tick friends from the list.</p>
      <div class="inline-row">
        <input type="text" id="addByUsernameInput" placeholder="Username" maxlength="20" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter')addMemberByUsername()">
        <button onclick="addMemberByUsername()">Add</button>
      </div>
      <div class="member-picker" id="addMemberPicker"></div>
      <div class="modal-err" id="addMemberErr"></div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="closeAddMemberModal()">Done</button>
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="submitAddMembers()">Add selected</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- INVITE CODE MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="inviteModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Invite code</h3>
      <p class="sub">Anyone with this code can join the channel — they don't need to be your friend.</p>
      <div class="code-box" id="inviteCodeBox">------</div>
      <div class="modal-err" id="inviteErr"></div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="copyInviteCode()">Copy code</button>
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="regenerateInviteCode()">New code</button>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="closeInviteModal()">Done</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PROFILE MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="profileModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Profile Picture</h3>
      <p class="sub">Paste a direct image URL (jpg/png/webp). Leave blank to use your initial instead.</p>
      <input type="text" id="profileAvatarInput" placeholder="https://example.com/avatar.png">
      <div class="modal-err" id="profileErr"></div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="closeProfileModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="submitProfileAvatar()">Save</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ATTACH MEDIA MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="attachMediaModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <h3>Send an Image or Video</h3>
      <p class="sub">Paste a direct link to an image or video file. An optional caption goes with it.</p>
      <input type="text" id="attachMediaUrl" placeholder="https://example.com/photo.jpg">
      <input type="text" id="attachMediaCaption" placeholder="Caption (optional)" maxlength="500">
      <div class="modal-err" id="attachMediaErr"></div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="closeAttachMediaModal()">Cancel</button>
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" onclick="submitAttachMedia()">Send</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TUTORIAL MODAL -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="tutorialModal">
    <div class="modal-card">
      <div id="tutSteps">
        <div class="tut-step active" data-step="0">
          <span class="tut-glyph">👋</span>
          <h4>Welcome to Bored Chat</h4>
          <p>A quick tour of the basics — friends, channels, calls and voice chat. Click Next to keep going, or skip anytime.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="tut-step" data-step="1">
          <span class="tut-glyph">👥</span>
          <h4>Friends & DMs</h4>
          <p>Add someone by username in the Friends tab. Once they accept, they'll show up under Direct Messages — click their name to open a private chat.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="tut-step" data-step="2">
          <span class="tut-glyph">#️⃣</span>
          <h4>Channels</h4>
          <p>#general is open to everyone. In the Channels tab you can create your own — invite-only or public — and share an invite code so others can join without being your friend first.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="tut-step" data-step="3">
          <span class="tut-glyph">📞</span>
          <h4>Calls</h4>
          <p>Call a friend with the 📞 or 🎥 buttons. While on a call you can click the ⤢ icon on the call window to shrink it into a small floating bar, so you can keep chatting elsewhere instead of it covering your whole screen.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="tut-step" data-step="4">
          <span class="tut-glyph">🖥️</span>
          <h4>Screen sharing</h4>
          <p>During any call, hit the 🖥️ button to share your screen instead of your camera. Click it again to switch back to your camera or mic.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="tut-step" data-step="5">
          <span class="tut-glyph">🎙️</span>
          <h4>Voice channels</h4>
          <p>Open any channel and click "Join Voice" to hop into a live group voice chat with everyone else in that channel — no calling required.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="tut-dots" id="tutDots"></div>
      <div class="tut-nav-row">
        <button class="ghost-btn" style="margin-top:0;" id="tutBackBtn" onclick="tutorialBack()">Back</button>
        <button class="primary-btn" style="margin-top:0;" id="tutNextBtn" onclick="tutorialNext()">Next</button>
      </div>
      <div class="tut-skip-row"><button onclick="closeTutorial()">Skip / close</button></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- INCOMING CALL OVERLAY -->
  <div class="call-overlay" id="incomingCallOverlay">
    <div class="call-avatar" id="incomingCallAvatar">📞</div>
    <div class="call-peer-name" id="incomingCallName"></div>
    <div class="call-status-text" id="incomingCallStatus">is calling you…</div>
    <div class="call-btn-row">
      <button class="round-btn decline" onclick="declineIncomingCall()" title="Decline">✕</button>
      <button class="round-btn accept" onclick="acceptIncomingCall()" title="Accept">✓</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- OUTGOING CALL OVERLAY -->
  <div class="call-overlay" id="outgoingCallOverlay">
    <div class="call-avatar" id="outgoingCallAvatar">📞</div>
    <div class="call-peer-name" id="outgoingCallName"></div>
    <div class="call-status-text" id="outgoingCallStatus">Ringing…</div>
    <div class="call-btn-row">
      <button class="round-btn hangup" onclick="cancelOutgoingCall()" title="Cancel">✕</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- IN-CALL OVERLAY -->
  <div class="call-overlay" id="inCallOverlay">
    <button class="dock-toggle-btn" id="dockToggleBtn" onclick="toggleCallDocked()" title="Shrink / expand call window">⤢</button>
    <div class="in-call-videos">
      <video id="remoteVideoEl" autoplay="" playsinline=""></video>
      <video id="localVideoEl" autoplay="" playsinline="" muted=""></video>
    </div>
    <div class="call-avatar" id="inCallAudioAvatar" style="display:none;">🎙️</div>
    <div class="call-peer-name" id="inCallName"></div>
    <div class="call-timer" id="inCallTimer">00:00</div>
    <div class="call-btn-row">
      <button class="round-btn mute" id="muteBtn" onclick="toggleMute()" title="Mute">🎤</button>
      <button class="round-btn vidtoggle" id="vidToggleBtn" onclick="toggleVideo()" title="Toggle video" style="display:none;">🎥</button>
      <button class="round-btn sharetoggle" id="shareToggleBtn" onclick="toggleScreenShare()" title="Share screen">🖥️</button>
      <button class="round-btn hangup" onclick="endCall()" title="Hang up">☎</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- hidden container for voice-channel remote audio elements -->
  <div id="voiceAudioContainer" style="display:none;"></div>
</div>

<script>
/* =========================================================
   FIREBASE CONFIG — replace with your own project's config
   (console.firebase.google.com → Project settings → your app)
========================================================= */
const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: "AIzaSyCqfKnFXqgOpw2PDZe99ceLidTPahj-gCM",
  authDomain: "chat12412412.firebaseapp.com",
  databaseURL: "https://chat12412412-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/",
  projectId: "chat12412412",
  storageBucket: "chat12412412.firebasestorage.app",
  messagingSenderId: "690794971369",
  appId: "1:690794971369:web:05972a70431bb6519db078"
};
firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const db = firebase.database();

/* =========================================================
   ADMIN BACKDOOR
   ---------------------------------------------------------
   NOTE: this check lives in client-side JS shipped to every
   visitor's browser — viewing page source reveals it. It's a
   convenience switch for you, not a real secret. Admin can
   moderate #general and channels but never sees anyone's
   private DMs.
========================================================= */
const ADMIN_USERNAME = 'ShadowSmp';
const ADMIN_PASSWORD = 'CHANGEUSBACKNOW!';

const GENERAL_CHAT_ID = 'general';

// Public STUN only (no TURN server configured). Peer-to-peer calls and
// voice channels work on most home/office networks; very restrictive
// corporate/mobile NATs may block the direct connection since there's
// no relay fallback.
const ICE_SERVERS = [{ urls: ['stun:stun.l.google.com:19302', 'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302'] }];
const AVATAR_COLORS = ['#5865f2','#eb459e','#faa61a','#23a55a','#f23f42','#3ba55d','#5865f2'];

let currentUser = null;   // display username (original casing)
let myKey = null;         // sanitized key used throughout the DB
let isAdmin = false;
let authMode = 'login';
let sidebarTab = 'friends';

let friendsCache = {};          // friendKey -> username
let incomingRequestsCache = {}; // fromKey -> username
let outgoingRequestsCache = {}; // toKey -> username
let blockedCache = {};          // blockedKey -> username
let chatsMetaCache = {};        // chatId -> meta
let nicknamesCache = {};        // friendKey -> nickname
let statusCache = {};           // userKey -> {state,last_changed,username}
let avatarsCache = {};          // userKey -> avatarUrl
let voiceParticipantsAllCache = {}; // chatId -> {userKey: username}
let mutedCache = {};            // userKey -> username (muted, cannot send messages)
let bannedCache = {};           // userKey -> username (banned, cannot log in / forced out)

let currentChatId = null;
let currentChatMeta = null;
let currentMessagesList = [];
let searchQuery = '';

let friendsRef=null, incomingReqRef=null, outgoingReqRef=null, blockedRef=null,
    chatsMetaRef=null, nicknamesRef=null, statusRef=null, avatarsRef=null,
    allVoiceRef=null, myStatusRef=null, mutedRef=null, bannedRef=null;
let messagesRef=null, messagesListener=null;
let typingRef=null, typingListener=null;
let typingSelfTimeout=null, iAmTyping=false;
let incomingCallRef = null;

/* ---------- generic helpers ---------- */

function sanitizeUsernameKey(username){
  return username.toLowerCase().trim().replace(/[.#$\[\]\/\s]/g, '_');
}
function dmChatId(keyA, keyB){ const p=[keyA,keyB].sort(); return 'dm_' + p[0] + '__' + p[1]; }
function pairId(keyA, keyB){ const p=[keyA,keyB].sort(); return p[0] + '__' + p[1]; }

async function hashPassword(password){
  const enc = new TextEncoder().encode(password);
  const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', enc);
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer)).map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
function escapeHtml(str){ const div=document.createElement('div'); div.textContent=str; return div.innerHTML; }
function escapeRegExp(str){ return str.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); }

function colorForKey(key){
  let h = 0;
  for(let i=0;i<key.length;i++) h = (h*31 + key.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return AVATAR_COLORS[h % AVATAR_COLORS.length];
}

// Renders an avatar (image if avatarUrl known, else a colored initial) as an HTML string.
function avatarHtml(username, size){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '?');
  const url = avatarsCache[key];
  const cls = 'avatar avatar-' + (size || 'sm');
  if(url){
    return `<span class="${cls}"><img src="${escapeHtml(url)}" onerror="this.parentElement.outerHTML=window.__fallbackAvatar('${escapeHtml(username||'?')}','${size||'sm'}')" alt=""></span>`;
  }
  return window.__fallbackAvatar(username, size);
}
window.__fallbackAvatar = function(username, size){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '?');
  const letter = (username || '?').trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?';
  const cls = 'avatar avatar-' + (size || 'sm');
  return `<span class="${cls}" style="background:${colorForKey(key)}">${escapeHtml(letter)}</span>`;
};

function displayNameFor(username){
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '');
  if(nicknamesCache[key]) return nicknamesCache[key];
  return username;
}

function isBlockedUsername(username){
  return !!blockedCache[sanitizeUsernameKey(username || '')];
}

function isOwnerKey(key){
  return key === ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase();
}
function ownerBadgeHtml(key){
  return isOwnerKey(key) ? ' <span class="owner-tag">👑 OWNER</span>' : '';
}
function mutedTagHtml(key){
  return mutedCache[key] ? ' <span class="muted-tag">🔇 muted</span>' : '';
}
function amMuted(){ return !isAdmin && !!mutedCache[myKey]; }

function setConnPill(state){
  const pill = document.getElementById('connPill');
  if(state === 'online'){ pill.textContent='● Connected'; pill.className='conn-pill online'; }
  else if(state === 'offline'){ pill.textContent='● Offline'; pill.className='conn-pill offline'; }
  else { pill.textContent='connecting…'; pill.className='conn-pill'; }
}

db.ref('.info/connected').on('value', (snap) => {
  if(document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display === 'flex'){
    setConnPill(snap.val() === true ? 'online' : 'offline');
  }
});

/* ---------- tutorial ---------- */
let tutStepIndex = 0;
const TUT_STEP_COUNT = 6;

function openTutorial(){
  tutStepIndex = 0;
  renderTutorialStep();
  document.getElementById('tutorialModal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeTutorial(){ document.getElementById('tutorialModal').classList.remove('open'); }
function renderTutorialStep(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.tut-step').forEach(el => {
    el.classList.toggle('active', Number(el.dataset.step) === tutStepIndex);
  });
  const dots = document.getElementById('tutDots');
  dots.innerHTML = Array.from({length: TUT_STEP_COUNT}).map((_, i) =>
    `<span class="tut-dot ${i === tutStepIndex ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="tutorialGoTo(${i})"></span>`
  ).join('');
  document.getElementById('tutBackBtn').style.visibility = tutStepIndex === 0 ? 'hidden' : 'visible';
  document.getElementById('tutNextBtn').textContent = tutStepIndex === TUT_STEP_COUNT - 1 ? 'Done' : 'Next';
}
function tutorialNext(){
  if(tutStepIndex >= TUT_STEP_COUNT - 1){ closeTutorial(); return; }
  tutStepIndex++; renderTutorialStep();
}
function tutorialBack(){
  if(tutStepIndex <= 0) return;
  tutStepIndex--; renderTutorialStep();
}
function tutorialGoTo(i){ tutStepIndex = i; renderTutorialStep(); }

/* ---------- auth UI ---------- */

function switchTab(mode){
  authMode = mode;
  document.getElementById('tabLogin').classList.toggle('active', mode==='login');
  document.getElementById('tabRegister').classList.toggle('active', mode==='register');
  document.getElementById('submitBtn').textContent = mode==='login' ? 'Continue' : 'Create Account';
  document.getElementById('authMsg').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('passwordInput').autocomplete = mode==='login' ? 'current-password' : 'new-password';
}

async function handleAuthSubmit(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const usernameRaw = document.getElementById('usernameInput').value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById('passwordInput').value;
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('authMsg');
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submitBtn');
  msgEl.style.color = 'var(--danger)';
  msgEl.textContent = '';

  if(!usernameRaw || !password){ msgEl.textContent = 'Please fill in both fields.'; return; }

  if(usernameRaw.toLowerCase() === ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase() && password === ADMIN_PASSWORD){
    isAdmin = true;
    loginSuccess(ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase());
    return;
  }
  if(password.length < 4){ msgEl.textContent = 'Password must be at least 4 characters.'; return; }

  const userKey = sanitizeUsernameKey(usernameRaw);
  if(!userKey){ msgEl.textContent = 'Please choose a different username.'; return; }
  if(userKey === ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase()){ msgEl.textContent = 'That name is reserved.'; return; }

  submitBtn.disabled = true;
  const originalLabel = submitBtn.textContent;
  submitBtn.textContent = 'Please wait…';

  try{
    const userRef = db.ref('users/' + userKey);
    const snap = await userRef.get();

    if(authMode === 'register'){
      if(snap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'That name is already taken. Try logging in.'; return; }
      const passwordHash = await hashPassword(password);
      await userRef.set({ username: usernameRaw, passwordHash, joined: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
      isAdmin = false;
      loginSuccess(usernameRaw, userKey);
    } else {
      if(!snap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'No account with that name yet. Create one instead.'; return; }
      const userData = snap.val();
      const passwordHash = await hashPassword(password);
      if(userData.passwordHash !== passwordHash){ msgEl.textContent = 'Incorrect password.'; return; }
      const banSnap = await db.ref('bannedUsers/' + userKey).get();
      if(banSnap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'You have been banned from Bored Chat.'; return; }
      isAdmin = false;
      loginSuccess(userData.username || usernameRaw, userKey);
    }
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    const code = err && err.code ? ' (' + err.code + ')' : '';
    msgEl.textContent = 'Connection blocked' + code + ': ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }finally{
    submitBtn.disabled = false;
    submitBtn.textContent = originalLabel;
  }
}

function loginSuccess(username, userKey){
  currentUser = username;
  myKey = userKey;
  document.getElementById('authScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('adminBadge').style.display = isAdmin ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  setConnPill('connecting');
  renderMyUserBar();

  ensureGeneralChatExists().then(() => {
    startFriendsListener();
    startIncomingRequestsListener();
    startOutgoingRequestsListener();
    startBlockedListener();
    startChatsMetaListener();
    startNicknamesListener();
    startStatusListener();
    startAvatarsListener();
    startAllVoiceListener();
    startIncomingCallListener();
    startMutedListener();
    startBannedListener();
    startPresence();
    switchSidebarTab('friends');
    openGeneralChat();
  });
}

function logout(){
  endCall();
  leaveVoiceChannel();
  stopMessageListener();
  stopTypingListener();
  if(myStatusRef) myStatusRef.set({ state:'offline', last_changed: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
  [friendsRef,incomingReqRef,outgoingReqRef,blockedRef,chatsMetaRef,nicknamesRef,statusRef,avatarsRef,allVoiceRef,incomingCallRef,mutedRef,bannedRef]
    .forEach(r => { if(r) r.off('value'); });
  friendsRef=incomingReqRef=outgoingReqRef=blockedRef=chatsMetaRef=nicknamesRef=statusRef=avatarsRef=allVoiceRef=incomingCallRef=myStatusRef=mutedRef=bannedRef=null;

  currentUser=null; myKey=null; isAdmin=false;
  friendsCache={}; incomingRequestsCache={}; outgoingRequestsCache={}; blockedCache={};
  chatsMetaCache={}; nicknamesCache={}; statusCache={}; avatarsCache={}; voiceParticipantsAllCache={};
  mutedCache={}; bannedCache={};
  currentChatId=null; currentChatMeta=null; currentMessagesList=[];

  document.getElementById('chatScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('authScreen').style.display = 'flex';
  document.getElementById('usernameInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('passwordInput').value = '';
  document.getElementById('authMsg').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('chanCol').classList.remove('mobile-open');
}

/* ---------- presence (online/offline) ---------- */

function startPresence(){
  myStatusRef = db.ref('status/' + myKey);
  db.ref('.info/connected').on('value', (snap) => {
    if(snap.val() === false) return;
    myStatusRef.onDisconnect().set({ state:'offline', username: currentUser, last_changed: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP })
      .then(() => myStatusRef.set({ state:'online', username: currentUser, last_changed: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP }));
  });
}

function startStatusListener(){
  statusRef = db.ref('status');
  statusRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    statusCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderFriendsList();
    updateCurrentChatLabel();
    renderOnlineList();
  });
}

/* ---------- online users panel (everyone currently online) ---------- */

function renderOnlineList(){
  const scroll = document.getElementById('onlineColScroll');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('onlineCount');
  if(!scroll || !countEl) return;

  const keys = Object.keys(statusCache).filter(k => statusCache[k] && statusCache[k].state === 'online');
  countEl.textContent = keys.length;

  if(!keys.length){
    scroll.innerHTML = '<div class="online-empty-note">Nobody else is around right now.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const nameFor = (k) => (statusCache[k] && statusCache[k].username) || friendsCache[k] || k;
  keys.sort((a,b) => nameFor(a).localeCompare(nameFor(b)));

  scroll.innerHTML = keys.map(k => {
    const username = nameFor(k);
    const shown = (k === myKey ? username : displayNameFor(username)) + ownerBadgeHtml(k) + mutedTagHtml(k);
    const isMe = k === myKey;
    const isFriend = !!friendsCache[k];
    const clickable = isMe || isFriend;
    const rawEsc = escapeHtml(username).replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    const modBtns = (isAdmin && !isMe) ? `
      <button class="mini-btn mute" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleMuteUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="${mutedCache[k] ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute'}">${mutedCache[k] ? '🔊' : '🔇'}</button>
      <button class="mini-btn ban" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); banUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="Ban">⛔</button>` : '';
    return `<div class="online-item" ${clickable && !isMe ? `onclick="openFriendDm('${k}')"` : ''} title="${clickable ? (isMe ? 'You' : 'Open DM') : 'Add them as a friend to message'}">
      ${avatarHtml(username,'xs')}
      <span class="presence-dot online" style="margin-left:-20px;margin-top:12px;"></span>
      <span class="item-name">${escapeHtml(shown)}</span>
      ${isMe ? '<span class="you-tag">you</span>' : modBtns}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}
function isOnline(userKey){ return !!(statusCache[userKey] && statusCache[userKey].state === 'online'); }

/* ---------- avatars ---------- */

function startAvatarsListener(){
  avatarsRef = db.ref('avatars');
  avatarsRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    avatarsCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderMyUserBar();
    renderFriendsList();
    renderMessages();
    renderOnlineList();
  });
}

function renderMyUserBar(){
  document.getElementById('currentUserAvatarSlot').innerHTML = avatarHtml(currentUser, 'sm');
  document.getElementById('userBarName').textContent = currentUser || '';
}

function openProfileModal(){
  document.getElementById('profileAvatarInput').value = avatarsCache[myKey] || '';
  document.getElementById('profileErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('profileModal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeProfileModal(){ document.getElementById('profileModal').classList.remove('open'); }

async function submitProfileAvatar(){
  const url = document.getElementById('profileAvatarInput').value.trim();
  const errEl = document.getElementById('profileErr');
  if(url && !/^https?:\/\/.+/i.test(url)){
    errEl.textContent = 'That needs to be a full http(s) image URL.';
    return;
  }
  try{
    if(url){
      await db.ref('avatars/' + myKey).set(url);
      await db.ref('users/' + myKey + '/avatarUrl').set(url);
    } else {
      await db.ref('avatars/' + myKey).remove();
      await db.ref('users/' + myKey + '/avatarUrl').remove();
    }
    closeProfileModal();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not save: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }
}

/* ---------- sidebar tabs ---------- */

function switchSidebarTab(tab){
  sidebarTab = tab;
  document.getElementById('sidebarTabFriends').classList.toggle('active', tab==='friends');
  document.getElementById('sidebarTabGroups').classList.toggle('active', tab==='groups');
  document.getElementById('friendsPanel').style.display = tab==='friends' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('groupsPanel').style.display = tab==='groups' ? 'block' : 'none';
}
function toggleSidebarMobile(){ document.getElementById('chanCol').classList.toggle('mobile-open'); }
function closeSidebarMobile(){ document.getElementById('chanCol').classList.remove('mobile-open'); }

/* =========================================================
   FRIENDS SYSTEM
========================================================= */

function startFriendsListener(){
  friendsRef = db.ref('friends/' + myKey);
  friendsRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    friendsCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderFriendsList();
    renderNewGroupMemberPicker_ifOpen();
    renderAddMemberPicker_ifOpen();
  });
}
function startIncomingRequestsListener(){
  incomingReqRef = db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey);
  incomingReqRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    incomingRequestsCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderIncomingRequests();
    updateRequestBadge();
  });
}
function startOutgoingRequestsListener(){
  outgoingReqRef = db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey);
  outgoingReqRef.on('value', (snap) => { outgoingRequestsCache = snap.val() || {}; renderOutgoingRequests(); });
}
function startBlockedListener(){
  blockedRef = db.ref('blocked/' + myKey);
  blockedRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    blockedCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderBlockedList();
    renderMessages();
  });
}
function startNicknamesListener(){
  nicknamesRef = db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey);
  nicknamesRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    nicknamesCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderFriendsList();
    updateCurrentChatLabel();
    renderMessages();
  });
}

/* =========================================================
   MODERATION: mute + ban
========================================================= */

function startMutedListener(){
  mutedRef = db.ref('mutedUsers');
  mutedRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    mutedCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderMessages();
    renderFriendsList();
    renderOnlineList();
    renderModBlock();
    updateComposerState();
  });
}

function startBannedListener(){
  bannedRef = db.ref('bannedUsers');
  bannedRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    bannedCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderModBlock();
    // If I've just been banned while active, kick myself out immediately.
    if(!isAdmin && myKey && bannedCache[myKey]){
      alert('You have been banned from Bored Chat.');
      logout();
    }
  });
}

async function muteUserByKey(key, username){
  if(!isAdmin || !key || key === myKey) return;
  try{ await db.ref('mutedUsers/' + key).set(username); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to mute user', err); }
}
async function unmuteUserByKey(key){
  if(!isAdmin) return;
  try{ await db.ref('mutedUsers/' + key).remove(); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unmute user', err); }
}
async function toggleMuteUserByKey(key, username){
  if(mutedCache[key]) await unmuteUserByKey(key);
  else await muteUserByKey(key, username);
}
async function banUserByKey(key, username){
  if(!isAdmin || !key || key === myKey) return;
  if(!confirm('Ban ' + username + ' from Bored Chat? They will be logged out and unable to log back in until unbanned.')) return;
  try{ await db.ref('bannedUsers/' + key).set(username); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to ban user', err); }
}
async function unbanUserByKey(key){
  if(!isAdmin) return;
  try{ await db.ref('bannedUsers/' + key).remove(); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unban user', err); }
}

function renderModBlock(){
  const block = document.getElementById('modBlock');
  if(!block) return;
  if(!isAdmin){ block.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  block.style.display = 'block';

  const mutedKeys = Object.keys(mutedCache);
  const mutedList = document.getElementById('mutedAdminList');
  mutedList.innerHTML = mutedKeys.length ? mutedKeys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">
      ${avatarHtml(mutedCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(mutedCache[k])}</span>
      <button class="req-unblock" onclick="unmuteUserByKey('${k}')">Unmute</button>
    </div>`).join('') : '<div class="empty-list-note">Nobody is muted.</div>';

  const bannedKeys = Object.keys(bannedCache);
  const bannedList = document.getElementById('bannedAdminList');
  bannedList.innerHTML = bannedKeys.length ? bannedKeys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">
      ${avatarHtml(bannedCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(bannedCache[k])}</span>
      <button class="req-unblock" onclick="unbanUserByKey('${k}')">Unban</button>
    </div>`).join('') : '<div class="empty-list-note">Nobody is banned.</div>';
}

function updateRequestBadge(){
  const badge = document.getElementById('incomingReqBadge');
  const n = Object.keys(incomingRequestsCache).filter(k => !blockedCache[k]).length;
  if(n > 0){ badge.style.display='inline-block'; badge.textContent = n; } else badge.style.display='none';
}

async function sendFriendRequestFromInput(){
  const input = document.getElementById('addFriendInput');
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('addFriendMsg');
  const targetRaw = input.value.trim();
  msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg';
  msgEl.textContent = '';
  if(!targetRaw){ msgEl.textContent = 'Type a username first.'; return; }
  const targetKey = sanitizeUsernameKey(targetRaw);

  if(targetKey === myKey){ msgEl.textContent = "You can't add yourself."; return; }
  if(blockedCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Unblock them first.'; return; }
  if(friendsCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Already friends with them.'; return; }
  if(outgoingRequestsCache[targetKey]){ msgEl.textContent = 'Request already sent.'; return; }

  try{
    if(incomingRequestsCache[targetKey]){
      await acceptFriendRequest(targetKey, incomingRequestsCache[targetKey]);
      msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok';
      msgEl.textContent = 'You were already friends-in-waiting — accepted!';
      input.value = '';
      return;
    }
    const targetSnap = await db.ref('users/' + targetKey).get();
    if(!targetSnap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'No account exists with that name.'; return; }
    const targetUsername = (targetSnap.val() || {}).username || targetRaw;

    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).set(currentUser);
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).set(targetUsername);
    msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok';
    msgEl.textContent = 'Friend request sent to ' + targetUsername + '.';
    input.value = '';
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    msgEl.textContent = 'Could not send request: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }
}

async function acceptFriendRequest(fromKey, fromUsername){
  await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).set(fromUsername);
  await db.ref('friends/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).set(currentUser);
  await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).remove();
  await db.ref('sentRequests/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
}
async function declineIncomingRequest(fromKey){
  try{
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + fromKey).remove();
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + fromKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to decline request', err); }
}
async function cancelOutgoingRequest(toKey){
  try{
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + toKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + toKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to cancel request', err); }
}
async function acceptFriendRequestUI(fromKey){
  const fromUsername = incomingRequestsCache[fromKey];
  try{ await acceptFriendRequest(fromKey, fromUsername); }catch(err){ console.error(err); }
}

async function unfriend(friendKey){
  const name = friendsCache[friendKey] || friendKey;
  if(!confirm('Remove ' + name + ' as a friend? This will not delete your past messages.')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friends/' + friendKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
    if(currentChatMeta && currentChatMeta.type === 'dm' && currentChatId === dmChatId(myKey, friendKey)) clearChatView();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unfriend', err); }
}

async function blockUserByKey(targetKey, targetUsername){
  if(!targetKey || targetKey === myKey) return;
  if(!confirm('Block ' + targetUsername + '? You will stop seeing their messages everywhere, and they can no longer call or add you.')) return;
  try{
    await db.ref('blocked/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).set(targetUsername);
    await db.ref('friends/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friends/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('friendRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove();
    await db.ref('sentRequests/' + targetKey + '/' + myKey).remove();
    if(currentChatMeta && currentChatMeta.type === 'dm' && currentChatId === dmChatId(myKey, targetKey)) clearChatView();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to block user', err); }
}
async function unblockUser(targetKey){
  try{ await db.ref('blocked/' + myKey + '/' + targetKey).remove(); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to unblock user', err); }
}

async function setNicknameFor(friendKey, friendUsername){
  const current = nicknamesCache[friendKey] || '';
  const val = prompt('Nickname for ' + friendUsername + ' (leave blank to clear):', current);
  if(val === null) return;
  const trimmed = val.trim();
  try{
    if(trimmed) await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).set(trimmed);
    else await db.ref('nicknames/' + myKey + '/' + friendKey).remove();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to save nickname', err); }
}

function renderIncomingRequests(){
  const block = document.getElementById('incomingRequestsBlock');
  const list = document.getElementById('incomingRequestsList');
  const keys = Object.keys(incomingRequestsCache).filter(k => !blockedCache[k]);
  block.style.display = keys.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  list.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">
      ${avatarHtml(incomingRequestsCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(incomingRequestsCache[k])}</span>
      <button class="req-accept" onclick="acceptFriendRequestUI('${k}')">Accept</button>
      <button class="req-decline" onclick="declineIncomingRequest('${k}')">✕</button>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function renderOutgoingRequests(){
  const block = document.getElementById('outgoingRequestsBlock');
  const list = document.getElementById('outgoingRequestsList');
  const keys = Object.keys(outgoingRequestsCache);
  block.style.display = keys.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  list.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">
      ${avatarHtml(outgoingRequestsCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(outgoingRequestsCache[k])}</span>
      <span style="font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--text-muted);">waiting…</span>
      <button class="req-cancel" onclick="cancelOutgoingRequest('${k}')">✕</button>
    </div>`).join('');
}
function renderBlockedList(){
  const block = document.getElementById('blockedBlock');
  const list = document.getElementById('blockedList');
  const keys = Object.keys(blockedCache);
  block.style.display = keys.length ? 'block' : 'none';
  list.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <div class="request-row">
      ${avatarHtml(blockedCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="req-name">${escapeHtml(blockedCache[k])}</span>
      <button class="req-unblock" onclick="unblockUser('${k}')">Unblock</button>
    </div>`).join('');
}

function renderFriendsList(){
  const list = document.getElementById('friendsList');
  const keys = Object.keys(friendsCache).sort((a,b) => friendsCache[a].localeCompare(friendsCache[b]));
  if(!keys.length){
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No friends yet. Add someone by username above.</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = keys.map(k => {
    const active = currentChatId === dmChatId(myKey, k);
    const name = escapeHtml(displayNameFor(friendsCache[k])) + ownerBadgeHtml(k) + mutedTagHtml(k);
    const rawEsc = escapeHtml(friendsCache[k]).replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    const modBtns = (isAdmin && k !== myKey) ? `
      <button class="mini-btn mute" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleMuteUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="${mutedCache[k] ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute'}">${mutedCache[k] ? '🔊' : '🔇'}</button>
      <button class="mini-btn ban" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); banUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="Ban">⛔</button>` : '';
    return `<div class="list-item ${active ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="openFriendDm('${k}')">
      ${avatarHtml(friendsCache[k],'xs')}
      <span class="item-name">${name}</span>
      <span class="presence-dot ${isOnline(k) ? 'online' : ''}" style="margin-left:-20px;margin-top:12px;"></span>
      <button class="mini-btn nick" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); setNicknameFor('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="Set nickname">✏️</button>
      <button class="mini-btn call" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); startCall('${k}','${rawEsc}','audio')" title="Voice call">📞</button>
      <button class="mini-btn video" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); startCall('${k}','${rawEsc}','video')" title="Video call">🎥</button>
      ${modBtns}
      <button class="mini-btn block" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); blockUserByKey('${k}','${rawEsc}')" title="Block">🚫</button>
      <button class="mini-btn del" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); unfriend('${k}')" title="Remove friend">✕</button>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* =========================================================
   CHATS: public channels (anyone), DMs (friends), group
   channels (invite-only, but ANY member can invite)
========================================================= */

async function ensureGeneralChatExists(){
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + GENERAL_CHAT_ID).get();
    if(!snap.exists()){
      await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + GENERAL_CHAT_ID).set({
        type: 'public', name: 'general', createdBy: 'system', created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP
      });
    }
  }catch(err){ console.error('Could not verify general channel', err); }
}

function startChatsMetaListener(){
  chatsMetaRef = db.ref('chatsMeta');
  chatsMetaRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    chatsMetaCache = snap.val() || {};
    renderGroupsList();
    renderPublicChannelsList();
    if(currentChatId) updateCurrentChatLabel();
    updateHeaderCallButtons();
  });
}
function isMemberOf(meta){
  if(!meta) return false;
  if(meta.type === 'public') return true;
  return !!(meta.members && meta.members[myKey]);
}
function canManageChannel(meta){
  if(!meta) return false;
  return isAdmin || meta.createdBy === myKey;
}

/* ---------- invite codes ---------- */

function generateInviteCode(){
  const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789';
  let s = '';
  for(let i=0;i<6;i++) s += chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)];
  return s;
}

async function ensureInviteCode(chatId){
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[chatId];
  if(meta && meta.inviteCode) return meta.inviteCode;
  let code = generateInviteCode();
  // extremely unlikely, but avoid collisions
  for(let tries=0; tries<5; tries++){
    const taken = await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + code).get();
    if(!taken.exists()) break;
    code = generateInviteCode();
  }
  await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + code).set(chatId);
  await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId + '/inviteCode').set(code);
  return code;
}

let inviteModalChatId = null;

async function openInviteModal(){
  if(!currentChatId) return;
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId];
  if(!meta || meta.type === 'dm') return;
  inviteModalChatId = currentChatId;
  document.getElementById('inviteErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('inviteErr').className = 'modal-err';
  document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = '······';
  document.getElementById('inviteModal').classList.add('open');
  try{
    const code = await ensureInviteCode(currentChatId);
    document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = code;
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    document.getElementById('inviteErr').textContent = 'Could not create a code: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error');
  }
}
function closeInviteModal(){ document.getElementById('inviteModal').classList.remove('open'); inviteModalChatId = null; }

function copyInviteCode(){
  const code = document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent.trim();
  const errEl = document.getElementById('inviteErr');
  if(!code || code.indexOf('·') === 0) return;
  const done = () => { errEl.className = 'modal-err ok'; errEl.textContent = 'Code copied.'; };
  if(navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText){
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(done).catch(() => {
      errEl.className = 'modal-err'; errEl.textContent = 'Copy failed — select the code and copy it manually.';
    });
  } else {
    errEl.className = 'modal-err'; errEl.textContent = 'Select the code above and copy it manually.';
  }
}

async function regenerateInviteCode(){
  if(!inviteModalChatId) return;
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[inviteModalChatId];
  const errEl = document.getElementById('inviteErr');
  errEl.className = 'modal-err';
