  if(!canManageChannel(meta)){ errEl.textContent = 'Only the channel creator or the owner can reset the code.'; return; }
  try{
    if(meta.inviteCode) await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + meta.inviteCode).remove();
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + inviteModalChatId + '/inviteCode').remove();
    const code = await ensureInviteCode(inviteModalChatId);
    document.getElementById('inviteCodeBox').textContent = code;
    errEl.className = 'modal-err ok';
    errEl.textContent = 'New code created. The old one no longer works.';
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not reset the code: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error');
  }
}

async function joinChannelByCode(){
  const input = document.getElementById('joinCodeInput');
  const msgEl = document.getElementById('joinCodeMsg');
  msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg';
  const code = input.value.trim().toUpperCase();
  if(!code){ msgEl.textContent = 'Paste an invite code first.'; return; }
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + code).get();
    if(!snap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'That code does not match any channel.'; return; }
    const chatId = snap.val();
    const metaSnap = await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId).get();
    if(!metaSnap.exists()){ msgEl.textContent = 'That channel no longer exists.'; return; }
    const meta = metaSnap.val();
    if(meta.type === 'group') await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId + '/members/' + myKey).set(true);
    input.value = '';
    msgEl.className = 'add-friend-msg ok';
    msgEl.textContent = 'Joined ' + (meta.name || 'the channel') + '.';
    openChat(chatId);
    closeSidebarMobile();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    msgEl.textContent = 'Could not join: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error');
  }
}

/* ---------- channel lists ---------- */

function renderPublicChannelsList(){
  const list = document.getElementById('publicChannelsList');
  if(!list) return;
  const ids = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).filter(id => chatsMetaCache[id] && chatsMetaCache[id].type === 'public');
  ids.sort((a,b) => {
    if(a === GENERAL_CHAT_ID) return -1;
    if(b === GENERAL_CHAT_ID) return 1;
    return (chatsMetaCache[a].created||0) - (chatsMetaCache[b].created||0);
  });
  if(!ids.length){ list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No public channels yet.</div>'; return; }
  list.innerHTML = ids.map(id => {
    const meta = chatsMetaCache[id];
    const active = id === currentChatId;
    const voiceCount = Object.keys(voiceParticipantsAllCache[id] || {}).length;
    const canDelete = isAdmin && id !== GENERAL_CHAT_ID;
    return `<div class="list-item ${active ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="openChatFromSidebar('${id}')">
      <span class="hash">#</span>
      <span class="item-name">${escapeHtml(meta.name || 'unnamed')}</span>
      ${voiceCount ? `<span class="voice-count">🎙️${voiceCount}</span>` : ''}
      <button class="mini-btn invite" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openInviteFor('${id}')" title="Invite code">🔗</button>
      ${canDelete ? `<button class="mini-btn del" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); deleteChannel('${id}')" title="Delete channel">✕</button>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function renderGroupsList(){
  const list = document.getElementById('groupsList');
  let ids = Object.keys(chatsMetaCache).filter(id => {
    const meta = chatsMetaCache[id];
    if(!meta || meta.type !== 'group') return false;
    return isMemberOf(meta) || isAdmin;
  });
  ids.sort((a,b) => (chatsMetaCache[a].created||0) - (chatsMetaCache[b].created||0));

  if(!ids.length){
    list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No channels yet. Create one, or join with an invite code.</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = ids.map(id => {
    const meta = chatsMetaCache[id];
    const active = id === currentChatId;
    const voiceCount = Object.keys(voiceParticipantsAllCache[id] || {}).length;
    const amMember = !!(meta.members && meta.members[myKey]);
    return `<div class="list-item ${active ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="openChatFromSidebar('${id}')">
      <span class="hash">#</span>
      <span class="item-name">${escapeHtml(meta.name || 'unnamed')}</span>
      ${voiceCount ? `<span class="voice-count">🎙️${voiceCount}</span>` : ''}
      <button class="mini-btn addppl" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openAddMemberFor('${id}')" title="Add people">＋</button>
      <button class="mini-btn invite" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); openInviteFor('${id}')" title="Invite code">🔗</button>
      ${amMember ? `<button class="mini-btn leave" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); leaveChannel('${id}')" title="Leave channel">🚪</button>` : ''}
      ${canManageChannel(meta) ? `<button class="mini-btn del" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); deleteChannel('${id}')" title="Delete channel">✕</button>` : ''}
    </div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function openChatFromSidebar(chatId){ openChat(chatId); closeSidebarMobile(); }
function openInviteFor(chatId){ openChat(chatId); setTimeout(openInviteModal, 30); }
function openAddMemberFor(chatId){ openChat(chatId); setTimeout(openAddMemberModal, 30); }

function openGeneralChat(){
  openChat(GENERAL_CHAT_ID);
}

function openFriendDm(friendKey){
  if(!friendsCache[friendKey]) return;
  const id = dmChatId(myKey, friendKey);
  ensureDmChatExists(id, friendKey).then(() => { openChat(id); closeSidebarMobile(); });
}

async function ensureDmChatExists(chatId, friendKey){
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId).get();
    if(!snap.exists()){
      const members = {}; members[myKey]=true; members[friendKey]=true;
      await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId).set({ type:'dm', members, created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
    }
  }catch(err){ console.error('Could not create/verify DM chat', err); }
}

function openChat(chatId){
  currentChatId = chatId;
  currentChatMeta = chatsMetaCache[chatId] || (chatId === GENERAL_CHAT_ID ? {type:'public', name:'general'} : null);
  currentMessagesList = [];
  closeSearch();
  document.getElementById('generalNavBtn').classList.toggle('active', chatId === GENERAL_CHAT_ID);
  renderFriendsList();
  renderGroupsList();
  renderPublicChannelsList();
  updateCurrentChatLabel();
  updateHeaderCallButtons();
  updateVoicePanelVisibility();
  updateComposerState();
  startMessageListener();
  startTypingListener();
}

function clearChatView(){
  stopMessageListener();
  stopTypingListener();
  currentChatId = null;
  currentChatMeta = null;
  currentMessagesList = [];
  document.getElementById('currentChatLabel').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('currentChatSub').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('messages').innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span class="glyph">👥</span>Pick #general, a friend, or a channel to begin.</div>';
  updateHeaderCallButtons();
  updateVoicePanelVisibility();
}

function updateCurrentChatLabel(){
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId] || currentChatMeta;
  currentChatMeta = meta || currentChatMeta;
  const label = document.getElementById('currentChatLabel');
  const sub = document.getElementById('currentChatSub');
  if(!meta){ label.textContent=''; sub.textContent=''; return; }
  if(meta.type === 'public'){
    label.textContent = '# ' + (meta.name || 'general');
    sub.textContent = 'Public channel — everyone can see and post here';
  } else if(meta.type === 'dm'){
    const otherKey = Object.keys(meta.members || {}).find(k => k !== myKey);
    const otherName = friendsCache[otherKey] || (otherKey || '');
    label.textContent = '@' + displayNameFor(otherName);
    sub.textContent = isOnline(otherKey) ? 'Online' : 'Offline';
  } else {
    label.textContent = '#' + (meta.name || 'unnamed');
    const n = Object.keys(meta.members || {}).length;
    sub.textContent = n + (n === 1 ? ' member' : ' members') + ' · anyone here can invite';
  }
}

function currentDmFriendKey(){
  if(!currentChatMeta || currentChatMeta.type !== 'dm') return null;
  return Object.keys(currentChatMeta.members || {}).find(k => k !== myKey) || null;
}

function updateHeaderCallButtons(){
  const audioBtn = document.getElementById('headerCallAudioBtn');
  const videoBtn = document.getElementById('headerCallVideoBtn');
  const addBtn = document.getElementById('headerAddPeopleBtn');
  const inviteBtn = document.getElementById('headerInviteBtn');
  const leaveBtn = document.getElementById('headerLeaveBtn');

  const friendKey = currentDmFriendKey();
  const showCall = !!friendKey && !!friendsCache[friendKey];
  audioBtn.style.display = showCall ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  videoBtn.style.display = showCall ? 'inline-block' : 'none';

  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId] || currentChatMeta;
  const isGroup = !!meta && meta.type === 'group';
  const isPublic = !!meta && meta.type === 'public';
  const amMember = isGroup && !!(meta.members && meta.members[myKey]);

  addBtn.style.display = isGroup ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  inviteBtn.style.display = (isGroup || isPublic) ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
  leaveBtn.style.display = amMember ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
}
function startCallWithCurrentFriend(type){
  const friendKey = currentDmFriendKey();
  if(!friendKey || !friendsCache[friendKey]) return;
  startCall(friendKey, friendsCache[friendKey], type);
}

/* ---------- new channel modal ---------- */
let newGroupSelected = new Set();
let newChannelType = 'group';

function setNewChannelType(type){
  newChannelType = type;
  document.getElementById('typeBtnPrivate').classList.toggle('active', type === 'group');
  document.getElementById('typeBtnPublic').classList.toggle('active', type === 'public');
  document.getElementById('newGroupPickerWrap').style.display = type === 'group' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('newGroupNote').textContent = type === 'public'
    ? 'Public channels show up for everyone, exactly like #general.'
    : "You'll get an invite code once it's created, so you can add people who aren't friends yet.";
}

function openNewGroupModal(){
  newGroupSelected = new Set();
  document.getElementById('newGroupName').value = '';
  document.getElementById('newGroupErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('newGroupTypeChoice').style.display = isAdmin ? 'flex' : 'none';
  setNewChannelType('group');
  renderNewGroupMemberPicker();
  document.getElementById('newGroupModal').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('newGroupName').focus(), 50);
}
function closeNewGroupModal(){ document.getElementById('newGroupModal').classList.remove('open'); }
function renderNewGroupMemberPicker_ifOpen(){ if(document.getElementById('newGroupModal').classList.contains('open')) renderNewGroupMemberPicker(); }
function renderNewGroupMemberPicker(){
  const picker = document.getElementById('newGroupMemberPicker');
  const keys = Object.keys(friendsCache).sort((a,b) => friendsCache[a].localeCompare(friendsCache[b]));
  if(!keys.length){ picker.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No friends to tick yet — create the channel anyway and share its invite code.</div>'; return; }
  picker.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <label class="member-row">
      <input type="checkbox" ${newGroupSelected.has(k) ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleNewGroupMember('${k}', this.checked)">
      <span>${escapeHtml(displayNameFor(friendsCache[k]))}</span>
    </label>`).join('');
}
function toggleNewGroupMember(key, checked){ if(checked) newGroupSelected.add(key); else newGroupSelected.delete(key); }

async function submitNewGroup(){
  const name = document.getElementById('newGroupName').value.trim();
  const errEl = document.getElementById('newGroupErr');
  errEl.className = 'modal-err';
  if(!name){ errEl.textContent = 'Give the channel a name.'; return; }
  const type = (isAdmin && newChannelType === 'public') ? 'public' : 'group';
  try{
    const newRef = db.ref('chatsMeta').push();
    if(type === 'public'){
      await newRef.set({ type:'public', name, createdBy: myKey, created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
    } else {
      const members = { [myKey]: true };
      newGroupSelected.forEach(k => members[k] = true);
      await newRef.set({ type:'group', name, members, createdBy: myKey, created: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
    }
    await ensureInviteCode(newRef.key);
    closeNewGroupModal();
    switchSidebarTab('groups');
    openChat(newRef.key);
    closeSidebarMobile();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not create channel: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }
}

/* ---------- add member modal (any member can use it) ---------- */
let addMemberSelected = new Set();
function openAddMemberModal(){
  if(!currentChatId || !currentChatMeta || currentChatMeta.type !== 'group') return;
  addMemberSelected = new Set();
  document.getElementById('addMemberErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('addMemberErr').className = 'modal-err';
  document.getElementById('addByUsernameInput').value = '';
  renderAddMemberPicker();
  document.getElementById('addMemberModal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeAddMemberModal(){ document.getElementById('addMemberModal').classList.remove('open'); }
function renderAddMemberPicker_ifOpen(){ if(document.getElementById('addMemberModal').classList.contains('open')) renderAddMemberPicker(); }
function renderAddMemberPicker(){
  const picker = document.getElementById('addMemberPicker');
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId];
  const members = (meta && meta.members) || {};
  const keys = Object.keys(friendsCache).filter(k => !members[k]).sort((a,b) => friendsCache[a].localeCompare(friendsCache[b]));
  if(!keys.length){ picker.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-list-note">No friends left to tick. Add someone by username above, or share the invite code.</div>'; return; }
  picker.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <label class="member-row">
      <input type="checkbox" ${addMemberSelected.has(k) ? 'checked' : ''} onchange="toggleAddMember('${k}', this.checked)">
      <span>${escapeHtml(displayNameFor(friendsCache[k]))}</span>
    </label>`).join('');
}
function toggleAddMember(key, checked){ if(checked) addMemberSelected.add(key); else addMemberSelected.delete(key); }

async function addMemberByUsername(){
  const input = document.getElementById('addByUsernameInput');
  const errEl = document.getElementById('addMemberErr');
  errEl.className = 'modal-err';
  const raw = input.value.trim();
  if(!raw){ errEl.textContent = 'Type a username first.'; return; }
  if(!currentChatId || !currentChatMeta || currentChatMeta.type !== 'group'){ errEl.textContent = 'Open a channel first.'; return; }
  const key = sanitizeUsernameKey(raw);
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId] || {};
  if(meta.members && meta.members[key]){ errEl.textContent = 'They are already in this channel.'; return; }
  try{
    const snap = await db.ref('users/' + key).get();
    const isOwnerAccount = key === ADMIN_USERNAME.toLowerCase();
    if(!snap.exists() && !isOwnerAccount){ errEl.textContent = 'No account exists with that name.'; return; }
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + currentChatId + '/members/' + key).set(true);
    const shown = snap.exists() ? ((snap.val() || {}).username || raw) : ADMIN_USERNAME;
    errEl.className = 'modal-err ok';
    errEl.textContent = shown + ' was added to the channel.';
    input.value = '';
    renderAddMemberPicker();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not add them: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error');
  }
}

async function submitAddMembers(){
  const errEl = document.getElementById('addMemberErr');
  errEl.className = 'modal-err';
  if(addMemberSelected.size === 0){ errEl.textContent = 'Tick at least one friend, or add someone by username.'; return; }
  try{
    const updates = {};
    addMemberSelected.forEach(k => { updates['chatsMeta/' + currentChatId + '/members/' + k] = true; });
    await db.ref().update(updates);
    addMemberSelected = new Set();
    errEl.className = 'modal-err ok';
    errEl.textContent = 'Added.';
    renderAddMemberPicker();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not add members: ' + (err && err.message ? err.message : 'unknown error');
  }
}

/* ---------- leaving / deleting channels ---------- */

async function leaveChannel(chatId){
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[chatId];
  if(!meta || meta.type !== 'group') return;
  if(!confirm('Leave "' + (meta.name || chatId) + '"? You can rejoin with an invite code.')) return;
  try{
    if(voiceState.chatId === chatId) await leaveVoiceChannel();
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId + '/members/' + myKey).remove();
    if(currentChatId === chatId) openGeneralChat();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to leave channel', err); }
}
function leaveCurrentChannel(){ if(currentChatId) leaveChannel(currentChatId); }

async function deleteChannel(chatId){
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[chatId];
  if(!meta) return;
  if(chatId === GENERAL_CHAT_ID){ alert('#general cannot be deleted.'); return; }
  if(!canManageChannel(meta)){ alert('Only the channel creator or the owner can delete this.'); return; }
  if(!confirm('Delete channel "' + (meta.name || chatId) + '" and all its messages?')) return;
  try{
    if(meta.inviteCode) await db.ref('inviteCodes/' + meta.inviteCode).remove();
    await db.ref('chatsMeta/' + chatId).remove();
    await db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + chatId).remove();
    await db.ref('voiceChannels/' + chatId).remove();
    if(currentChatId === chatId) openGeneralChat();
  }catch(err){ console.error('Failed to delete channel', err); }
}
// kept for backwards compatibility with older handlers
function deleteGroup(chatId){ deleteChannel(chatId); }

/* ---------- messages (scoped to currentChatId) ---------- */

function startMessageListener(){
  stopMessageListener();
  const chatId = currentChatId;
  document.getElementById('messages').innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Loading…</div>';
  messagesRef = db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + chatId).limitToLast(200);
  messagesListener = messagesRef.on('value', (snapshot) => {
    if(chatId !== currentChatId) return;
    const data = snapshot.val() || {};
    const list = Object.keys(data).map(key => ({ id:key, ...data[key] }));
    list.sort((a,b) => (a.time||0) - (b.time||0));
    currentMessagesList = list;
    renderMessages();
  }, (err) => console.error('Message listener error:', err));
}
function stopMessageListener(){
  if(messagesRef && messagesListener) messagesRef.off('value', messagesListener);
  messagesRef = null; messagesListener = null;
}

function highlightMatch(rawText, query){
  const safe = escapeHtml(rawText || '');
  if(!query) return safe;
  const safeQuery = escapeHtml(query);
  const re = new RegExp(escapeRegExp(safeQuery), 'ig');
  return safe.replace(re, (match) => '<mark class="hl">' + match + '</mark>');
}

function mediaHtmlFor(url){
  if(!url) return '';
  const safe = escapeHtml(url);
  if(/\.(mp4|webm|ogv|mov|m4v)(\?|#|$)/i.test(url)){
    return `<video class="msg-media" src="${safe}" controls playsinline></video>`;
  }
  return `<img class="msg-media" src="${safe}" alt="" onclick="window.open(this.src,'_blank')">`;
}

function renderMessages(){
  const container = document.getElementById('messages');
  const wasNearBottom = container.scrollHeight - container.scrollTop - container.clientHeight < 80;
  const list = currentMessagesList.filter(m => m.user === currentUser || !isBlockedUsername(m.user));
  const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

  if(!list.length){
    container.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><span class="glyph">💬</span>No messages yet. Say something to break the ice.</div>';
    updateSearchCount(0, 0);
    return;
  }

  let matchCount = 0;
  container.innerHTML = list.map(m => {
    const mine = m.user === currentUser;
    const time = m.time ? new Date(m.time).toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : '';
    const text = m.text || '';
    const user = m.user || 'unknown';
    const shownName = displayNameFor(user);

    const isMatch = q && (text.toLowerCase().includes(q) || shownName.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    if(isMatch) matchCount++;
    const dimClass = (q && !isMatch) ? ' dimmed' : '';

    const safeText = highlightMatch(text, q);
    const safeUser = highlightMatch(shownName, q);
    const media = mediaHtmlFor(m.media);
    const delBtn = isAdmin ? `<button class="msg-del-btn" onclick="deleteMessage('${m.id}')" title="Delete message">✕</button>` : '';
    const blockBtn = !mine ? `<button class="msg-block-btn" onclick="blockUserByKey('${sanitizeUsernameKey(user)}','${escapeHtml(user).replace(/'/g,"\\'")}')" title="Block ${escapeHtml(user)}">🚫</button>` : '';

    return `<div class="msg ${mine ? 'me' : 'other'}${dimClass}">
      <div class="avatar-slot">${avatarHtml(user,'md')}</div>
      <div class="msg-body">
        <div class="name-row"><span class="who">${safeUser}${ownerBadgeHtml(sanitizeUsernameKey(user))}</span><span class="when">${time}</span></div>
        <div class="bubble">${safeText}</div>
        ${media}
      </div>
      <div class="msg-actions">${blockBtn}${delBtn}</div>
    </div>`;
  }).join('');

  updateSearchCount(matchCount, list.length);
  if(wasNearBottom || list.length <= 1) container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
}

/* ---------- typing indicator ---------- */

function startTypingListener(){
  stopTypingListener();
  const chatId = currentChatId;
  typingRef = db.ref('typing/' + chatId);
  typingListener = typingRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    if(chatId !== currentChatId) return;
    const data = snap.val() || {};
    const others = Object.keys(data).filter(k => k !== myKey && data[k]);
    const bar = document.getElementById('typingBar');
    if(!others.length){ bar.textContent = ''; return; }
    const names = others.map(k => displayNameFor(friendsCache[k] || (statusCache[k] && statusCache[k].username) || k));
    bar.textContent = (names.length === 1 ? names[0] + ' is typing…' : names.join(', ') + ' are typing…');
  });
}
function stopTypingListener(){
  if(typingRef && typingListener) typingRef.off('value', typingListener);
  typingRef = null; typingListener = null;
  document.getElementById('typingBar').textContent = '';
  clearMyTypingFlag();
}
function handleTypingInput(){
  if(!currentChatId) return;
  if(!iAmTyping){
    iAmTyping = true;
    db.ref('typing/' + currentChatId + '/' + myKey).set(true);
    db.ref('typing/' + currentChatId + '/' + myKey).onDisconnect().remove();
  }
  clearTimeout(typingSelfTimeout);
  typingSelfTimeout = setTimeout(clearMyTypingFlag, 2500);
}
function clearMyTypingFlag(){
  if(iAmTyping && currentChatId) db.ref('typing/' + currentChatId + '/' + myKey).remove().catch(()=>{});
  iAmTyping = false;
  clearTimeout(typingSelfTimeout);
}

/* ---------- search ---------- */

function toggleSearch(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('searchBar');
  const btn = document.getElementById('searchToggleBtn');
  const isOpen = bar.classList.toggle('open');
  btn.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
  if(isOpen) setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('searchInput').focus(), 30);
  else closeSearch();
}
function closeSearch(){
  document.getElementById('searchBar').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('searchToggleBtn').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('searchInput').value = '';
  searchQuery = '';
  updateSearchCount(0, 0, true);
  renderMessages();
}
function handleSearchInput(){ searchQuery = document.getElementById('searchInput').value; renderMessages(); }
function updateSearchCount(matchCount, totalCount, hide){
  const el = document.getElementById('searchCount');
  if(hide || !searchQuery.trim()){ el.textContent = ''; return; }
  el.textContent = matchCount + ' of ' + totalCount;
}

async function deleteMessage(msgId){
  if(!isAdmin || !currentChatId) return;
  try{ await db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + currentChatId + '/' + msgId).remove(); }
  catch(err){ console.error('Failed to delete message', err); }
}

function updateComposerState(){
  const note = document.getElementById('composerNote');
  const input = document.getElementById('msgInput');
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
  const attach = document.getElementById('attachBtn');
  const muted = amMuted();
  note.style.display = muted ? 'block' : 'none';
  input.disabled = muted;
  sendBtn.disabled = muted;
  attach.disabled = muted;
  input.placeholder = muted ? "You can't send messages while muted" : 'Message…';
}

async function sendMessage(){
  const input = document.getElementById('msgInput');
  const sendBtn = document.getElementById('sendBtn');
  const text = input.value.trim();
  if(!text || !currentUser || !currentChatId) return;
  if(amMuted()){ updateComposerState(); return; }
  input.value = '';
  sendBtn.disabled = true;
  clearMyTypingFlag();
  try{
    const newMsgRef = db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + currentChatId).push();
    await newMsgRef.set({ user: currentUser, text, time: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
  }catch(err){
    console.error('Failed to send message', err);
    input.value = text;
  }finally{
    sendBtn.disabled = false;
    input.focus();
  }
}

/* ---------- attach image / video ---------- */

function openAttachMediaModal(){
  if(!currentChatId) return;
  if(amMuted()) return;
  document.getElementById('attachMediaUrl').value = '';
  document.getElementById('attachMediaCaption').value = '';
  document.getElementById('attachMediaErr').textContent = '';
  document.getElementById('attachMediaModal').classList.add('open');
  setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('attachMediaUrl').focus(), 50);
}
function closeAttachMediaModal(){ document.getElementById('attachMediaModal').classList.remove('open'); }

async function submitAttachMedia(){
  const url = document.getElementById('attachMediaUrl').value.trim();
  const caption = document.getElementById('attachMediaCaption').value.trim();
  const errEl = document.getElementById('attachMediaErr');
  errEl.textContent = '';
  if(!url){ errEl.textContent = 'Paste a link first.'; return; }
  if(!/^https?:\/\/.+/i.test(url)){ errEl.textContent = 'That needs to be a full http(s) link.'; return; }
  if(!currentChatId){ errEl.textContent = 'Open a chat first.'; return; }
  try{
    const newMsgRef = db.ref('chatsMsgs/' + currentChatId).push();
    await newMsgRef.set({ user: currentUser, text: caption, media: url, time: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP });
    closeAttachMediaModal();
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    errEl.textContent = 'Could not send: ' + (err.message || 'unknown error');
  }
}

/* =========================================================
   1:1 CALLING (WebRTC, signaled through Firebase RTDB)
========================================================= */

let callState = {
  active:false, role:null, peerKey:null, peerUsername:null, type:null,
  pc:null, localStream:null, outgoingRef:null, remoteCandidatesRef:null,
  timerInterval:null, startTime:null, currentIncomingCallKey:null,
  cameraTrack:null, screenSharing:false
};

function startIncomingCallListener(){
  incomingCallRef = db.ref('calls/' + myKey);
  incomingCallRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    const data = snap.val();
    if(!data){
      if(callState.active && callState.role === 'callee') cleanupCall();
      hideIncomingCallUI();
      callState.currentIncomingCallKey = null;
      return;
    }
    if(data.status === 'ringing'){
      if(blockedCache[data.from]){ db.ref('calls/' + myKey).update({status:'declined', reason:'blocked'}); return; }
      const callKey = data.from + '_' + (data.time || '');
      if(callState.active){ db.ref('calls/' + myKey).update({status:'declined', reason:'busy'}); return; }
      if(callState.currentIncomingCallKey !== callKey){
        callState.currentIncomingCallKey = callKey;
        showIncomingCallUI(data);
      }
    } else if(data.status === 'ended' || data.status === 'declined'){
      if(callState.active && callState.role === 'callee') cleanupCall();
      hideIncomingCallUI();
      callState.currentIncomingCallKey = null;
    }
  });
}

function newPeerConnection(){
  const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: ICE_SERVERS });
  pc.ontrack = (event) => {
    const remoteVideo = document.getElementById('remoteVideoEl');
    if(remoteVideo.srcObject !== event.streams[0]) remoteVideo.srcObject = event.streams[0];
  };
  return pc;
}
async function getLocalStream(type){ return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio:true, video: type==='video' }); }

async function startCall(friendKey, friendUsername, type){
  if(callState.active){ alert("You're already on a call."); return; }
  if(!friendsCache[friendKey]){ alert('You can only call friends.'); return; }
  if(blockedCache[friendKey]){ alert('Unblock them first.'); return; }

  try{
    const existing = await db.ref('calls/' + friendKey).get();
    if(existing.exists() && existing.val().status === 'ringing'){ alert(friendUsername + ' already has a call ringing.'); return; }
    callState.localStream = await getLocalStream(type);
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    alert('Could not access microphone' + (type==='video' ? '/camera' : '') + '. Check your browser permissions.');
    return;
  }

  callState.active = true; callState.role = 'caller'; callState.peerKey = friendKey;
  callState.peerUsername = friendUsername; callState.type = type;

  const pc = newPeerConnection();
  callState.pc = pc;
  callState.localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => pc.addTrack(track, callState.localStream));
  pc.onicecandidate = (event) => { if(event.candidate) db.ref('calls/' + friendKey + '/callerCandidates').push(event.candidate.toJSON()); };

  try{
    const offer = await pc.createOffer();
    await pc.setLocalDescription(offer);
    await db.ref('calls/' + friendKey).set({
      from: myKey, fromUsername: currentUser, type, status:'ringing',
      offer:{type:offer.type, sdp:offer.sdp}, time: firebase.database.ServerValue.TIMESTAMP
    });
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); cleanupCall(); alert('Could not start the call.'); return; }

  callState.outgoingRef = db.ref('calls/' + friendKey);
  callState.outgoingRef.on('value', handleOutgoingCallUpdate);
  callState.remoteCandidatesRef = db.ref('calls/' + friendKey + '/calleeCandidates');
  callState.remoteCandidatesRef.on('child_added', (snap) => {
    if(callState.pc) callState.pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(snap.val())).catch(console.error);
  });

  showOutgoingCallUI(friendUsername, type);
}

async function handleOutgoingCallUpdate(snapshot){
  const data = snapshot.val();
  if(!callState.active || callState.role !== 'caller') return;
  if(!data){ cleanupCall(); return; }
  if(data.status === 'accepted' && data.answer && callState.pc && !callState.pc.currentRemoteDescription){
    try{ await callState.pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.answer)); hideOutgoingCallUI(); showInCallUI(); }
    catch(err){ console.error(err); }
  } else if(data.status === 'declined'){ hideOutgoingCallUI(); cleanupCall(); }
  else if(data.status === 'ended'){ cleanupCall(); }
}
function cancelOutgoingCall(){
  if(callState.role === 'caller' && callState.peerKey){
    db.ref('calls/' + callState.peerKey).update({status:'ended'})
      .then(() => setTimeout(() => db.ref('calls/' + callState.peerKey).remove(), 1000));
  }
  cleanupCall();
}

function showIncomingCallUI(data){
  document.getElementById('incomingCallName').textContent = data.fromUsername || data.from;
  document.getElementById('incomingCallAvatar').textContent = data.type === 'video' ? '🎥' : '📞';
  document.getElementById('incomingCallStatus').textContent = (data.type === 'video' ? 'Video call' : 'Voice call') + ' — incoming…';
  document.getElementById('incomingCallOverlay').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('incomingCallOverlay').dataset.callData = JSON.stringify(data);
}
function hideIncomingCallUI(){ document.getElementById('incomingCallOverlay').classList.remove('open'); }

async function acceptIncomingCall(){
  const overlay = document.getElementById('incomingCallOverlay');
  let data; try{ data = JSON.parse(overlay.dataset.callData || '{}'); }catch(e){ data = null; }
  hideIncomingCallUI();
  if(!data || !data.from) return;

  try{ callState.localStream = await getLocalStream(data.type); }
  catch(err){ console.error(err); alert('Could not access microphone' + (data.type==='video'?'/camera':'') + '. Declining call.'); declineIncomingCallRaw(); return; }

  callState.active = true; callState.role='callee'; callState.peerKey=data.from;
  callState.peerUsername=data.fromUsername; callState.type=data.type;

  const pc = newPeerConnection();
  callState.pc = pc;
  callState.localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => pc.addTrack(track, callState.localStream));
  pc.onicecandidate = (event) => { if(event.candidate) db.ref('calls/' + myKey + '/calleeCandidates').push(event.candidate.toJSON()); };

  try{
    await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.offer));
    const answer = await pc.createAnswer();
    await pc.setLocalDescription(answer);
    await db.ref('calls/' + myKey).update({ status:'accepted', answer:{type:answer.type, sdp:answer.sdp} });
  }catch(err){ console.error(err); cleanupCall(); return; }

  callState.remoteCandidatesRef = db.ref('calls/' + myKey + '/callerCandidates');
  callState.remoteCandidatesRef.on('child_added', (snap) => {
    if(callState.pc) callState.pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(snap.val())).catch(console.error);
  });
  showInCallUI();
}
function declineIncomingCallRaw(){
  db.ref('calls/' + myKey).update({status:'declined'}).then(() => setTimeout(() => db.ref('calls/' + myKey).remove(), 1000));
  callState.currentIncomingCallKey = null;
}
function declineIncomingCall(){ hideIncomingCallUI(); declineIncomingCallRaw(); }

function showOutgoingCallUI(name, type){
  document.getElementById('outgoingCallAvatar').textContent = type === 'video' ? '🎥' : '📞';
  document.getElementById('outgoingCallName').textContent = name;
  document.getElementById('outgoingCallStatus').textContent = 'Ringing…';
  document.getElementById('outgoingCallOverlay').classList.add('open');
}
function hideOutgoingCallUI(){ document.getElementById('outgoingCallOverlay').classList.remove('open'); }

function showInCallUI(){
  const overlay = document.getElementById('inCallOverlay');
  overlay.classList.remove('docked');
  document.getElementById('dockToggleBtn').textContent = '⤢';
  document.getElementById('inCallName').textContent = callState.peerUsername || '';
  document.getElementById('localVideoEl').srcObject = callState.localStream;
  const isVideo = callState.type === 'video';
  overlay.classList.toggle('in-call-audio-mode', !isVideo);
  document.getElementById('inCallAudioAvatar').style.display = isVideo ? 'none' : 'flex';
  document.getElementById('vidToggleBtn').style.display = isVideo ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
  overlay.classList.add('open');
  callState.startTime = Date.now();
  updateCallTimer();
  callState.timerInterval = setInterval(updateCallTimer, 1000);
  document.getElementById('muteBtn').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('muteBtn').textContent = '🎤';
  document.getElementById('vidToggleBtn').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('vidToggleBtn').textContent = '🎥';
  document.getElementById('shareToggleBtn').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('shareToggleBtn').textContent = '🖥️';
}
function hideInCallUI(){
  document.getElementById('inCallOverlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('inCallOverlay').classList.remove('docked');
  document.getElementById('remoteVideoEl').srcObject = null;
  document.getElementById('localVideoEl').srcObject = null;
  if(callState.timerInterval){ clearInterval(callState.timerInterval); callState.timerInterval = null; }
}
function updateCallTimer(){
  if(!callState.startTime) return;
  const secs = Math.floor((Date.now() - callState.startTime) / 1000);
  document.getElementById('inCallTimer').textContent = String(Math.floor(secs/60)).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(secs%60).padStart(2,'0');
}
function toggleMute(){
  if(!callState.localStream) return;
  const track = callState.localStream.getAudioTracks()[0];
  if(!track) return;
  track.enabled = !track.enabled;
  document.getElementById('muteBtn').classList.toggle('active', !track.enabled);
  document.getElementById('muteBtn').textContent = track.enabled ? '🎤' : '🔇';
}
function toggleVideo(){
  if(!callState.localStream) return;
  const track = callState.localStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
  if(!track) return;
  track.enabled = !track.enabled;
  document.getElementById('vidToggleBtn').classList.toggle('active', !track.enabled);
  document.getElementById('vidToggleBtn').textContent = track.enabled ? '🎥' : '🚫';
}

/* shrink/expand the in-call window so it doesn't block the whole screen */
function toggleCallDocked(){
  const overlay = document.getElementById('inCallOverlay');
  if(!overlay.classList.contains('open')) return;
  const nowDocked = overlay.classList.toggle('docked');
  document.getElementById('dockToggleBtn').textContent = nowDocked ? '⤡' : '⤢';
}

/* ---------- screen sharing during a call ---------- */
async function toggleScreenShare(){
  if(!callState.active || !callState.pc) return;
  if(callState.screenSharing){
    await stopScreenShare();
    return;
  }
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia){
    alert('Screen sharing is not supported in this browser.');
    return;
  }
  let screenStream;
  try{
    screenStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ video: true, audio: false });
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    return; // user cancelled the picker
  }
  const screenTrack = screenStream.getVideoTracks()[0];
  if(!screenTrack) return;

  const sender = callState.pc.getSenders().find(s => s.track && s.track.kind === 'video');
  const existingVideoTrack = callState.localStream.getVideoTracks()[0] || null;
  callState.cameraTrack = existingVideoTrack;

  if(sender){
    await sender.replaceTrack(screenTrack);
  } else {
    callState.pc.addTrack(screenTrack, callState.localStream);
  }

  if(existingVideoTrack){ callState.localStream.removeTrack(existingVideoTrack); }
  callState.localStream.addTrack(screenTrack);
  document.getElementById('localVideoEl').srcObject = callState.localStream;

  // switch UI into "video" layout so the shared screen is visible, even for audio calls
  const overlay = document.getElementById('inCallOverlay');
  overlay.classList.remove('in-call-audio-mode');
  document.getElementById('inCallAudioAvatar').style.display = 'none';

  callState.screenSharing = true;
  document.getElementById('shareToggleBtn').classList.add('active');
  document.getElementById('shareToggleBtn').textContent = '🛑';

  // if the user stops sharing via the browser's own "Stop sharing" control
  screenTrack.onended = () => { stopScreenShare(); };
}

async function stopScreenShare(){
  if(!callState.screenSharing) return;
  const sender = callState.pc ? callState.pc.getSenders().find(s => s.track && s.track.kind === 'video') : null;
  const screenTrack = callState.localStream ? callState.localStream.getVideoTracks()[0] : null;

  if(callState.cameraTrack && sender){
    await sender.replaceTrack(callState.cameraTrack);
  } else if(sender && callState.type !== 'video'){
    // audio-only call had no camera track to restore — drop video entirely
    callState.pc.removeTrack(sender);
  }

  if(screenTrack){
    if(callState.localStream) callState.localStream.removeTrack(screenTrack);
    screenTrack.stop();
  }
  if(callState.cameraTrack && callState.localStream) callState.localStream.addTrack(callState.cameraTrack);
  document.getElementById('localVideoEl').srcObject = callState.localStream;

  const overlay = document.getElementById('inCallOverlay');
  const stillVideo = callState.type === 'video';
  overlay.classList.toggle('in-call-audio-mode', !stillVideo);
  document.getElementById('inCallAudioAvatar').style.display = stillVideo ? 'none' : 'flex';

  callState.screenSharing = false;
  callState.cameraTrack = null;
  document.getElementById('shareToggleBtn').classList.remove('active');
  document.getElementById('shareToggleBtn').textContent = '🖥️';
}

function endCall(){
  if(!callState.active){
    if(document.getElementById('outgoingCallOverlay').classList.contains('open')) cancelOutgoingCall();
    return;
  }
  if(callState.screenSharing) stopScreenShare();
  const rootKey = callState.role === 'caller' ? callState.peerKey : myKey;
  if(rootKey){
    db.ref('calls/' + rootKey).update({status:'ended'})
      .then(() => setTimeout(() => db.ref('calls/' + rootKey).remove(), 1000)).catch(()=>{});
  }
  cleanupCall();
}
function cleanupCall(){
  if(callState.localStream) callState.localStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
  if(callState.cameraTrack) { try{ callState.cameraTrack.stop(); }catch(e){} }
  if(callState.pc){ callState.pc.onicecandidate=null; callState.pc.ontrack=null; callState.pc.close(); }
  if(callState.outgoingRef) callState.outgoingRef.off('value', handleOutgoingCallUpdate);
  if(callState.remoteCandidatesRef) callState.remoteCandidatesRef.off('child_added');
  hideOutgoingCallUI(); hideInCallUI();
  callState = { active:false, role:null, peerKey:null, peerUsername:null, type:null, pc:null, localStream:null,
    outgoingRef:null, remoteCandidatesRef:null, timerInterval:null, startTime:null,
    currentIncomingCallKey: callState.currentIncomingCallKey, cameraTrack:null, screenSharing:false };
}

/* =========================================================
   VOICE CHANNELS INSIDE CHANNELS (group + public)
   Full audio mesh: every participant opens a direct WebRTC
   connection to every other participant (no SFU/media server),
   so this suits a handful of people at a time.
========================================================= */

let voiceState = { chatId:null, localStream:null, peers:{} };
let voiceParticipantsListenerRef = null;

function startAllVoiceListener(){
  allVoiceRef = db.ref('voiceChannels');
  allVoiceRef.on('value', (snap) => {
    const data = snap.val() || {};
    voiceParticipantsAllCache = {};
    Object.keys(data).forEach(chatId => { voiceParticipantsAllCache[chatId] = data[chatId].participants || {}; });
    renderGroupsList();
    renderPublicChannelsList();
    if(voiceState.chatId) renderVoiceChips();
    updateVoiceStatusBar();
  });
}

function updateVoicePanelVisibility(){
  const panel = document.getElementById('voicePanel');
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[currentChatId] || currentChatMeta;
  const canVoice = !!meta && (meta.type === 'group' || meta.type === 'public');
  panel.classList.toggle('show', canVoice);
  if(canVoice) renderVoiceChips();
}

function renderVoiceChips(){
  const row = document.getElementById('voiceChipsRow');
  const participants = (voiceParticipantsAllCache[currentChatId] || {});
  const keys = Object.keys(participants);
  row.innerHTML = keys.map(k => `
    <span class="voice-chip">${avatarHtml(participants[k],'xs')}${escapeHtml(displayNameFor(participants[k]))}${k===myKey && voiceState.chatId===currentChatId ? ' (you)' : ''}</span>
  `).join('');
  const joinBtn = document.getElementById('voiceJoinBtn');
  const inThisChannel = voiceState.chatId === currentChatId;
  joinBtn.textContent = inThisChannel ? '🎙️ Leave Voice' : '🎙️ Join Voice';
  joinBtn.classList.toggle('leave', inThisChannel);
}

function updateVoiceStatusBar(){
  const bar = document.getElementById('voiceStatusBar');
  if(!voiceState.chatId){ bar.classList.remove('show'); return; }
  const meta = chatsMetaCache[voiceState.chatId];
  document.getElementById('voiceStatusName').textContent = 'In voice — ' + (meta ? meta.name : 'channel');
  bar.classList.add('show');
}

function voiceJoinBtnClick(){
  if(voiceState.chatId === currentChatId) leaveVoiceChannel();
  else joinVoiceChannel(currentChatId);
}

async function joinVoiceChannel(chatId){
  if(voiceState.chatId){ await leaveVoiceChannel(); }
  try{
    voiceState.localStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio:true });
  }catch(err){
    console.error(err);
    alert('Could not access your microphone. Check browser permissions.');
    return;
  }
  voiceState.chatId = chatId;
  voiceState.peers = {};

  const participantsRef = db.ref('voiceChannels/' + chatId + '/participants');
  const myParticipantRef = participantsRef.child(myKey);
  myParticipantRef.onDisconnect().remove();
  await myParticipantRef.set(currentUser);

  voiceParticipantsListenerRef = participantsRef;
  participantsRef.on('child_added', (snap) => {
    const otherKey = snap.key;
    if(otherKey === myKey || voiceState.chatId !== chatId) return;
    connectToVoicePeer(chatId, otherKey);
  });
  participantsRef.on('child_removed', (snap) => {
    const otherKey = snap.key;
    teardownVoicePeer(chatId, otherKey, true);
  });

  updateVoiceStatusBar();
  updateVoicePanelVisibility();
}

function connectToVoicePeer(chatId, otherKey){
  if(voiceState.peers[otherKey]) return;
  const amInitiator = myKey < otherKey;
  const pid = pairId(myKey, otherKey);
  const signalRef = db.ref('voiceChannels/' + chatId + '/signals/' + pid);

  const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({ iceServers: ICE_SERVERS });
  const audioEl = document.createElement('audio');
  audioEl.autoplay = true;
  audioEl.id = 'voice-audio-' + otherKey;
  document.getElementById('voiceAudioContainer').appendChild(audioEl);

  pc.ontrack = (event) => { audioEl.srcObject = event.streams[0]; };
  voiceState.localStream.getTracks().forEach(t => pc.addTrack(t, voiceState.localStream));

  voiceState.peers[otherKey] = { pc, audioEl, signalRef };

  if(amInitiator){
    pc.onicecandidate = (event) => { if(event.candidate) signalRef.child('callerCandidates').push(event.candidate.toJSON()); };
    pc.createOffer().then(offer => pc.setLocalDescription(offer)).then(() => {
      signalRef.set({ callerKey: myKey, calleeKey: otherKey, offer: { type: pc.localDescription.type, sdp: pc.localDescription.sdp } });
    }).catch(console.error);

    signalRef.on('value', (snap) => {
      const data = snap.val();
      if(data && data.answer && pc.currentRemoteDescription === null){
        pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.answer)).catch(console.error);
      }
    });
    signalRef.child('calleeCandidates').on('child_added', (snap) => { pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(snap.val())).catch(console.error); });
  } else {
    pc.onicecandidate = (event) => { if(event.candidate) signalRef.child('calleeCandidates').push(event.candidate.toJSON()); };
    let answered = false;
    signalRef.on('value', async (snap) => {
      const data = snap.val();
      if(data && data.offer && !answered){
        answered = true;
        try{
          await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(data.offer));
          const answer = await pc.createAnswer();
          await pc.setLocalDescription(answer);
          await signalRef.update({ answer: { type: answer.type, sdp: answer.sdp } });
        }catch(err){ console.error(err); }
      }
    });
    signalRef.child('callerCandidates').on('child_added', (snap) => { pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(snap.val())).catch(console.error); });
  }
}

function teardownVoicePeer(chatId, otherKey, cleanupSignalNode){
  const peer = voiceState.peers[otherKey];
  if(!peer) return;
  peer.signalRef.off('value');
  peer.signalRef.child('callerCandidates').off('child_added');
  peer.signalRef.child('calleeCandidates').off('child_added');
  peer.pc.ontrack = null; peer.pc.onicecandidate = null; peer.pc.close();
  if(peer.audioEl){ peer.audioEl.srcObject = null; peer.audioEl.remove(); }
  delete voiceState.peers[otherKey];
  if(cleanupSignalNode) db.ref('voiceChannels/' + chatId + '/signals/' + pairId(myKey, otherKey)).remove().catch(()=>{});
}

async function leaveVoiceChannel(){
  if(!voiceState.chatId) return;
  const chatId = voiceState.chatId;
  Object.keys(voiceState.peers).forEach(k => teardownVoicePeer(chatId, k, false));
  if(voiceParticipantsListenerRef){ voiceParticipantsListenerRef.off('child_added'); voiceParticipantsListenerRef.off('child_removed'); }
  voiceParticipantsListenerRef = null;
  if(voiceState.localStream) voiceState.localStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
  await db.ref('voiceChannels/' + chatId + '/participants/' + myKey).remove().catch(()=>{});
  voiceState = { chatId:null, localStream:null, peers:{} };
  updateVoiceStatusBar();
  if(currentChatId === chatId) updateVoicePanelVisibility();
}

/* Enter key submits the open modal */
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if(e.key !== 'Enter') return;
  if(document.getElementById('newGroupModal').classList.contains('open')) submitNewGroup();
});
</script>

</body></html>
